featureFlagOmnirouteEmergencyFallbackDes: Ziga arịrịọ ndị mmefu ego ha gwụrụ na provider/model ndabere efu maka ọnọdụ mberede.
featureFlagArenaEloSyncEnabledDescriptio: Gbanye mmekọrịta ELO nke leaderboard Arena AI kwa oge maka ogo ọgụgụ isi model.
featureFlagUniversalContextHandoffEnable: Mepụta ma tinye nchịkọta mkparịta ụka mgbe combo routing gbanwere model. Gbanyụọ ya ka e were mgbanwe model ọ bụla dịka ihe nọọrọ onwe ya ma gbochie arịrịọ nnyefe na ndabere maka combo niile dị ugbu a na ndị ga-adị n'ọdịnihu.
featureFlagExposeCcDiscoveryAliasesDescr: Kpọsa id mirror claude/<provider>/<model> na /v1/models ka nchọpụta model nke gateway Claude Code depụta model ndị na-abụghị Claude. Ịdọ aka ná ntị: nke a na-eme ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe dị na katalọgụ bụrụ okpukpu abụọ maka client niile mgbe agbanyere ya n'ụwa niile.
featureFlagNoThinkingAliasEnabledDescrip: Mgbanwe ukwu maka alias gateway no-think/<provider>/<model>. Agbanye (ndabara): /v1/models na-akpọsa ụdị na-adịghị eche echiche maka model Claude ọ bụla tozuru etozu nke nwere ike iche echiche, ma id no-think/ e zigara na arịrịọ ga-alaghachi na model n'ezie ebe a kwụsịrị reasoning. Agbanyụọ: a gaghị akpọsa ụdị ọ bụla, a ga-ewerekwa id no-think/ dịka id model ọ bụla ọzọ a na-amaghị. Nhọrọ ịbanye/ịpụ ModelSpec.noThinkingAlias nke model ọ bụla ka na-emetụta mgbe agbanyere nke a.
featureFlagChatVirtualLanesEnabledDescri: Gbanye lane nnabata virtual na-agbanwe onwe ya maka tenant ọ bụla maka iziga na provider (#9654): mgbawa arịrịọ nke otu tenant agaghịzi eme ka nke tenant ọzọ nweta 503. Env var OMNIROUTE_CHAT_VIRTUAL_LANES na-akarị mgbanwe dashboard a; mgbanwe ga-amalite ịrụ ọrụ mgbe e bidogharịrị server.
featureFlagFreeBadgeRequiresProviderFree: Ibe ndị na-enye ọrụ na dashboard: gosi akara Free naanị na signal ndị onye na-enye ọrụ na-akwado — nke a na-ewepụ usoro ntule dabere n’aha ngosi, oghere free ndị na-abụghị boolean, na mgbakwunye :free n’aha ndị na-enye ọrụ e debanyere aha nke na-enweghị ọkwa efu edepụtara. Mgbe agbanyụrụ ya, a ga-edobe iwu akara e ji eme ihe kemgbe.
featureFlagProxySkipRecentlyFailedDescri: Ọdọ proxy na ntụgharị opencode nke akaụntụ ọ bụla na-akwụsị iji proxy dara ugbu a ọzọ (nnyocha TCP a jụrụ, ma ọ bụ nzaghachi 429 e nwetara site na ya) ruo oge nke usoro ọ bụla nke na-amụba okpukpu abụọ mgbe ọdịda ahụ megharịrị, ruo n'ókè kachasị. A naghị ede ọkwa proxy ọ bụla; mgbe e wepụrụ ndị niile a ga-ahọrọ n'akụkụ, nhọrọ ahụ anaghị agbanwe. A gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara: usoro nhọrọ bụ kpọmkwem ntụgharị nkịtị.
featureFlagProxyPoolEgressObservationDes: Gosi, n'okpuru ọdọ proxy na dashboard, IP ọpụpụ ole a hụrụ jere ndị otu ya ozi n'ime awa 24 gara aga, njikọ ole jiri ha, na ọnụ ọgụgụ kachasị a hụrụ n'azụ otu IP. Ọ bụ naanị maka ọgụgụ, a na-agbakọ ya site na ndekọ proxy, a naghị eji ya eme routing. A gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara: editọ ọdọ ahụ anaghị agbanwe, route nlele ahụ na-azaghachi null.
featureFlagProxyHealthBlockedResetsStrea: N'oge nyocha ahụike proxy, kwe ka nyocha ebumnuche jụrụ (401/403/429: proxy ahụ zigara ya, ebe njedebe ahụ jụrụ IP ọpụpụ a) tọgharịa usoro ọdịda na-aga n'ihu nke proxy ahụ, dịka nyocha e jere ozi. A gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara: ọjụjụ na-anọpụ iche ma na-edobe usoro ahụ. 5xx ka na-enweghị nkwubi okwu n'ọnọdụ ọ bụla, ọjụjụ anaghị ewepụ, gbanyụọ, ma ọ bụ mee ka proxy rụọ ọrụ ọzọ.
featureFlagBatchAndFileAutoCleanupEnable: Kwe ka nhichapụ akpaka hichapụ ọrụ Batch API ndị nọ n’ọnọdụ njedebe (completed/failed/cancelled/expired) ma gafee OMNIROUTE_BATCH_RETENTION_DAYS, tinyere checkpoints nke ahịrị nke ọ bụla, ma kpochapụ ọdịnaya BLOB nke faịlụ ebugoro nke gafere expires_at nke ha. Agbanyụrụ ya na ndabara: nrụnye niile dị ugbu a ga-edobe data a kpọmkwem dịka ọ dị na mbụ ruo mgbe onye njikwa họrọ ịgbanye ya. Ụzọ DELETE /api/v1/batches/delete-completed nke onye njikwa na-akpalite agaghị emetụta n’ụzọ ọ bụla -- ọ bụ nkwekọrịta API ọha dị iche nke na-arụ ọrụ mgbe niile.
featureFlagXaiOauthLiveModelDiscoveryDes: Weta katalọgụ ụdị xAI dị ugbu a maka njikọ xai-oauth site na https://api.x.ai/v1/models, jiri OAuth bearer token, kama iji mkpụrụ static a kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ. Agbanyụrụ ya na ndabara: xai-oauth ga-aga n’ihu inye mkpụrụ static ahụ n’enweghị mgbanwe. Ọ bụrụ na njehie ọ bụla emee mgbe a na-achọpụta ya, nchọpụta ahụ ga-alaghachi n’iji mkpụrụ ahụ.
featureFlagDbHealthcheckStartupDeferredE: Mee nyocha iguzosi ike n’ezi ihe/ahụike nke database mgbe server malitere ịnabata arịrịọ, kama igbochi mmalite ruo mgbe nyocha ahụ gwụchara. Agbanyụrụ ya na ndabara: mmalite ga-echere nyocha ahụ kpọmkwem dịka ọ dị tupu mgbanwe a, ya mere a ka ga-achọpụta database mebiri emebi tupu e jeere arịrịọ mbụ ozi.

howItWorks.step1: Họrọ onye na-enye njikọ (dịka Slack, Discord, ma ọ bụ webhook ahaziri iche) ma hazie nkọwa njikọ ahụ.

howItWorks.timeoutNote: Nnyefe webhook nwere oke oge nke sekọnd 10.
howItWorks.retryNote: A na-anwaleghachi nnyefe ndị dara ada ruo ugboro 5 site na exponential backoff.

howItWorks.hmacRecipePython: Nnyocha HMAC na Python: hmac.new(secret, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

priority.when: Ị nwere otu model kachasị amasị gị ma chọọ naanị ndabere ma ọ daa.
priority.avoid: Ị chọrọ ka e kesaa arịrịọ n'etiti model dị iche iche.

weighted.when: Ị chọrọ ikesa okporo ụzọ n'etiti model dị iche iche n'ụzọ a na-achịkwa.
weighted.avoid: Ị gaghị enwe ike idobe weight ndị ziri ezi ka oge na-aga.
weighted.example: 80% model kwụsiri ike + 20% mwepụta model canary.

round-robin.when: Ị chọrọ nkesa a pụrụ ibu amụma ma bụrụ nke hà nhata.
round-robin.avoid: Model ndị ahụ dị nnọọ iche n’oge nzaghachi ma ọ bụ ọnụahịa.
round-robin.example: Otu model ahụ na ọtụtụ akaụntụ iji kesaa ikike nhazi.

random.when: Ị chọrọ nkesa dị mfe nke chọrọ nhazi pere mpe.
random.avoid: Ị chọrọ nkwa siri ike gbasara nkesa okporo arịrịọ.
random.example: Ime prototype ngwa ngwa site na model ndị ha nhata.

least-used.when: Ị chọrọ imezi nguzozi akpaghị aka dabere n'ọchịchọ dị ugbu a.
least-used.avoid: Okporo arịrịọ pere nnọọ mpe nke na ọ gaghị erite uru na nguzozi ojiji.
least-used.example: Ọrụ agwakọtara ebe otu model na-ebukarị ibu karịa oke.

cost-optimized.when: Ibelata ọnụahịa bụ ihe kacha gị mkpa.
cost-optimized.avoid: Data ọnụahịa adịghị ma ọ bụ bụrụ nke ochie.
cost-optimized.example: Ọrụ ndabere ma ọ bụ ọrụ batch ebe a na-ahọrọ ọnụahịa dị ala.

reset-aware.when: Ị na-ebufe arịrịọ n'etiti ọtụtụ akaụntụ nwere telemetry oke ojiji na oge nrụgharị dị iche iche.
reset-aware.avoid: Telemetry oke ojiji adịghị maka ọtụtụ akaụntụ.
reset-aware.example: Họrọ akaụntụ nwere oke ojiji kwa izu nke dị na 60% ma ga-amalitegharị echi karịa akaụntụ dị na 80% nke ga-amalitegharị ma e mesịa.

strict-random.when: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ nkesa hà nhata nke ọma — a ga-eji model ọ bụla otu ugboro tupu e megharịa nke ọ bụla.
strict-random.avoid: Zere ya mgbe model nwere ogo ma ọ bụ oge nzaghachi dị iche iche, ma usoro ha dị mkpa.
strict-random.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Ọtụtụ akaụntụ nke otu model ahụ iji kesaa ojiji n'ụzọ hà nhata.

p2c.when: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ nhọrọ nwere obere oge nzaghachi site na iji Power-of-Two-Choices algorithm.
p2c.avoid: Zere ya maka obere njikọta nwere model 2 ma ọ bụ ole na ole — ọ dịghị uru ọ karịrị round-robin.
p2c.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Inference nwere nnukwu ikike nhazi n'ofe endpoint nke model 4+ ha nhata.

context-relay.when: Jiri ya mgbe nnọkọ ogologo ga-anagide mgbanwe akaụntụ n’enweghị context a na-arụ ọrụ na ya efu.
context-relay.avoid: Zere ya mgbe mgbanwe akaụntụ anaghị emekarị ma ọ bụ mgbe ị chọghị arịrịọ nchịkọta ndị ọzọ.
context-relay.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Nnọkọ Codex ndị na-agbanwe n'etiti ọtụtụ akaụntụ mgbe oke ojiji fọrọ nke nta ka ọ gwụ.

fill-first.when: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ imecha oke ojiji nke otu provider kpamkpam tupu ịgafe na nke ọzọ.
fill-first.avoid: Zere ya mgbe ịchọrọ nguzozi ibu n'ogo arịrịọ n'etiti provider dị iche iche.
fill-first.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Jiri kredit Deepgram niile dị $200 tupu ịlaghachi na Groq.

auto.when: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ routing dabere na akara sitere n'ọtụtụ ihe dịka ọnụahịa, oge nzaghachi, na ogo.
auto.avoid: Zere ya mgbe ịchọrọ usoro mkpa siri ike ma ọ bụ ka akụkọ gara aga nọgide na-adị.
auto.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Dozie nguzozi arịrịọ n'etiti model nwere ike dị iche iche.

lkgp.when: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ ime routing dabere na ọnụego ihe ịga nke ọma na arụmọrụ gara aga.
lkgp.avoid: Zere ya mgbe data akụkọ gara aga pere mpe ma ọ bụ enweghị ntụkwasị obi.
lkgp.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Ziga arịrịọ na model ndị nwere ezigbo ndekọ arụmọrụ n'ọrụ ụfọdụ.

context-optimized.when: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ imezi ojiji context window n'ofe model dị iche iche.
context-optimized.avoid: Zere ya mgbe model nwere ogologo context yiri ibe ha ma ọ bụ mgbe ọrụ ndị ahụ dị mfe.
context-optimized.example: Ọmụmaatụ: Kesaa mkparịta ụka ogologo n'etiti model nwere context window buru ibu.

advancedHelp.maxRetries: Ọnụọgụ mbọgharị a na-eme tupu e kwuo na arịrịọ ahụ dara.
advancedHelp.retryDelay: Oge nchere mbụ n'etiti mbọgharị. Uru dị elu na-ebelata nrụgide arịrịọ mberede.
advancedHelp.timeout: Oge kacha ogologo arịrịọ nwere ike iwe tupu a kwụsị ya.
advancedHelp.healthcheck: Na-awụpụ model/provider ndị na-adịghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma na mkpebi routing.
advancedHelp.concurrencyPerModel: Ọnụọgụ arịrịọ kacha elu e kwere ka otu model hazie n'otu oge na round-robin.
advancedHelp.queueTimeout: Ogologo oge arịrịọ nwere ike ichere n'ahịrị tupu oge ya agwụ.
advancedHelp.failoverBeforeRetry: Mgbe enyere ya ikike, njehie upstream ọ bụla na-akpalite ịgafe ozugbo na combo target na-esote, na-amafere retries na fallback URLs niile.
advancedHelp.maxSetRetries: Ọnụọgụ ugboro a ga-anwaleghachi target set zuru ezu mgbe target niile dara. 0 = enweghị set-level retry.
advancedHelp.setRetryDelayMs: Oge nkwụsị n'etiti mbọ set-level retry, iji nye nsogbu na-adịru nwa oge ohere idozi onwe ha.
advancedHelp.targetTimeoutMs: Oge ngwụcha nhọrọ maka ebumnuche ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ọ tọgbọ chakoo, ọ ga-eketa oge ngwụcha nke arịrịọ dị ugbu a; a ga-amachi ụkpụrụ ndị ka ukwuu n'oge ngwụcha ahụ.
advancedHelp.comboTimeoutMs: Oge nhọrọ zuru ezu nke ngwakọta niile nwere ike iji gafee ebumnuche failover niile. Ọ bụrụ na ọ tọgbọ chakoo, ọ ga-edowe nkwụsị mgbochi ịkwụgide nke nkeji 10; ụkpụrụ dị mma ga-anọchi ya. Mee ka nke a dị ogologo karịa oge ngwụcha ebumnuche ka failover ka nwee oge.
advancedHelp.disableSessionStickiness: Gbanwee gaa na connection dị iche n'arịrịọ ọ bụla kama ijikọ mkparịta ụka dum na otu connection site na hash nke ozi mbụ. Nke a na-akagbu global default. Hapụ ya na Inherit iji chekwaa prompt-cache hits maka nkata nwere ọtụtụ ntụgharị.

priority.title: Ntọala ndabere nchekwa
priority.description: Jiri otu ụdị bụ isi ma debe usoro ndabere ahụ ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ ma bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịdabere na ya.
priority.tip1: Buru ụzọ tinye model gị kacha nwee ntụkwasị obi.
priority.tip2: Debe model nkwado 1-2 nwere ogo yiri ya.
priority.tip3: Jiri mgbalị ọzọ dị nchebe iji nagide ọdịda provider na-adịru nwa oge.

weighted.title: Nkewa traffic a na-achịkwa
weighted.description: Ọ dị mma maka mwepụta canary na iji nwayọọ kwaga n'etiti model dị iche iche.
weighted.tip1: Malite na nkewa akpachapụrụ anya dịka 90/10.
weighted.tip2: Debe mkpokọta ya na 100% ma mee ka ọ guzozie onwe ya mgbe mgbanwe gasịrị.
weighted.tip3: Nyochaa ihe ịga nke ọma na latency tupu ịbawanye ibu canary.

round-robin.title: Nkekọrịta load a pụrụ ibu n'amụma
round-robin.description: Kacha mma mgbe model hà nhata ma ịchọrọ nkesa na-aga werewere.
round-robin.tip2: Tọọ oke concurrency iji zere burst overload.
round-robin.tip3: Jiri queue timeout ka ọdịda mee ngwa ngwa mgbe saturation dị.

random.title: Nkesa ngwa ngwa nwere nhazi pere mpe
random.description: Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ nkesa dị mfe na-enweghị nkwa siri ike.
random.tip1: Jiri model nwere profaịlụ latency yiri ibe ha.
random.tip2: Hapụ retries ka ha dị n'ọrụ iji nagide ọdịda na-enweghị usoro.
random.tip3: Họrọ nke a maka nnwale, ọ bụghị maka SLAs siri ike.

least-used.title: Ime ka ibu guzozie n'ụzọ na-agbanwe onwe ya
least-used.description: Na-eziga arịrịọ na model ndị a na-eji obere oge iji belata hotspots ka oge na-aga.
least-used.tip1: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma karịa n'okpuru traffic na-aga n'ihu.
least-used.tip2: Jikọta ya na health checks maka nhazi dị nchebe karịa.
least-used.tip3: Soro ojiji model nke ọ bụla iji kwado uru nkesa.

cost-optimized.title: Routing na-ebute budget ụzọ
cost-optimized.description: Na-eziga arịrịọ na model dị ọnụ ala mgbe metadata ọnụahịa dị.
cost-optimized.tip1: Gbaa mbọ hụ na ozi ọnụahịa dị maka model niile ahọpụtara.
cost-optimized.tip2: Debe ndabere dị mma maka prompt ndị siri ike.
cost-optimized.tip3: Jiri ya maka ọrụ batch/background ebe ọnụ ahịa bụ KPI bụ isi.

reset-aware.title: Ntugharị account na-eburu reset n'uche
reset-aware.description: Na-eme ka quota provider fọdụrụ na oge reset guzozie.
reset-aware.tip1: Jiri account steps doro anya ma ọ bụ routing dabere na account-tag maka provider nwere quota telemetry.
reset-aware.tip2: Hazie ịdị arọ nke session na nke weekly mgbe mmebi quota nke obere oge nwere ihe ize ndụ karịa.
reset-aware.tip3: Debe tie band ka ọ pere mpe ka account ndị hà nhata wee na-atụgharịkwa n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

strict-random.title: Nkesa Deck A Gwakọtara
strict-random.description: A na-eji model ọ bụla kpọmkwem otu ugboro n'ime cycle ọ bụla tupu a gwakọta ha ọzọ.
strict-random.tip1: Jiri opekata mpe model 2 ka nkesa nwee isi.
strict-random.tip2: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ kacha mma na model nwere arụmọrụ hà nhata.
strict-random.tip3: Ọ kacha mma maka load balancing n'ofe ọtụtụ akaụntụ API.

fill-first.description: Mechaa quota provider n'otu n'otu tupu ịlaghachi na fallback.
fill-first.tip1: Jiri ya maka routing dabere na quota nke nwere fallback chains doro anya.
fill-first.tip2: Tọọ oke ojiji nke ọma iji zere ịgbanwe ụzọ tupu oge eruo.
fill-first.tip3: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ kacha mma na ndị na-eweta ọrụ nwere ọkwa efu ma ọ bụ nchịkọta kredit.
fill-first.title: Mmecha Quota

auto.description: Kpebie ụzọ dabere na akara ozugbo maka ọnụ ahịa, oge nzaghachi, ogo, na ọnọdụ arụmọrụ.
auto.tip1: Kwe ka injin ahụ dozie ọtụtụ ihe na-akpaghị aka.
auto.tip2: Nyochaa n'ime ndekọ ihe ndị na-emetụta mkpebi ịhọrọ ụzọ.
auto.tip3: Jiri ya maka ibu ọrụ dị mgbagwoju anya ebe ọ dịghị otu ihe kacha emetụta ihe niile.
auto.title: Nkwalite Dabere na Ọtụtụ Ihe

lkgp.description: Kpebie ụzọ dabere na arụmọrụ gara aga na usoro ihe ịga nke ọma.
lkgp.tip1: Ọ chọrọ akụkọ arịrịọ zuru ezu iji mee amụma ziri ezi.
lkgp.tip2: Ọ dị mma maka ibu ọrụ nwere usoro arụmọrụ model na-adịgide otu.
lkgp.tip3: Nyochaa izi ezi nke amụma ma gbanwee arọ dịka ọ dị mkpa.
lkgp.title: Nhọrọ Ụzọ Dabere na Akụkọ Gara Aga

context-optimized.description: Kwalite nhọrọ ụzọ dabere na ojiji windo context na iji token eme ihe nke ọma.
context-optimized.tip1: Ziga mkparịta ụka ogologo na models nwere windo context buru ibu.
context-optimized.tip2: Nyochaa ojiji context iji zere ịla token n'iyi.
context-optimized.tip3: Ọ kacha mma maka AI mkparịta ụka nke chọrọ idowe ọtụtụ context.
context-optimized.title: Nkwalite Context

context-relay.description: Ọ kacha mma mgbe a na-atụ anya mgbanwe akaụntụ, ma akaụntụ na-esote ga-anata nchịkọta ọrụ dị mfe.
context-relay.tip1: Jiri ya na ndị na-eweta ọrụ na-agbanwe akaụntụ maka otu ezinụlọ model.
context-relay.tip2: Tọọ oke nnyefe n'okpuru oke quota siri ike ka oge dị maka imepụta nchịkọta.
context-relay.tip3: Tọọ model nchịkọta pụrụ iche naanị ma ọ bụrụ na nke bụ isi dị oke ọnụ ma ọ bụ anaghị akwụsi ike.
context-relay.title: Ibu Ụzọ Maka Ịga n'Ihu Session

p2c.description: Ziga arịrịọ na onye na-eweta ọrụ nwere ibu kacha nta ugbu a, dabere na metrics ozugbo.
p2c.tip1: Nyochaa metrics ọnọdụ ndị na-eweta ọrụ iji tụọ ibu n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
p2c.tip2: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ kacha mma na nchịkọta ndị na-eweta ọrụ yiri ibe ha.
p2c.tip3: Gbanwee ogo mmetụta ya iji zere mgbanwe ugboro ugboro mgbe traffic na-arị elu na mberede.
p2c.title: Ike nke Nhọrọ Abụọ

concept.title: Ncheta Mkparịta Ụka
concept.description: OmniRoute na-amụta site na mkparịta ụka ọ bụla, na-echeta eziokwu, ihe omume, usoro, na echiche semantic ndị na-eme ka nzaghachi zie ezi karị ma mara ọnọdụ gbara ya gburugburu.
concept.howWorksContent:
1. Mwepụta akpaka: na njedebe nke nzaghachi ọ bụla, a na-achọpụta eziokwu na ihe omume ma chekwaa ha na-akpaghị aka.
2. Nweghachite: tupu nzaghachi ọ bụla, a na-achọ ncheta ndị kacha mkpa site na FTS5 (kpọmkwem), vector (semantic), ma ọ bụ hybrid RRF.
3. Ntinye: a na-etinye ncheta ndị dị mkpa na context onye enyemaka iji meziwanye ogo nzaghachi.
4. Nlekọta: jiri ibe a lee, dezie, bupụ, ma mee ka ncheta ochie dị kọmpatị.

providers.compatUpstreamHeadersHint: Ntọala nwere ikike dị elu — ọ nwere otu ọkwa ntụkwasị obi dịka idezi nzere API nke provider; naanị ndị nchịkwa a tụkwasịrị obi kwesịrị iji ya. A na-ejikọta ya mgbe OmniRoute tinyechara nkwenye njirimara sitere na igodo API nke provider. Ọ bụrụ na nkụnye isi ahaziri ahazi jiri otu aha dị ka nke dịbu (dịka Authorization), uru gị ga-anọchi nkụnye isi emepụtara na-akpaghị aka kpamkpam (gụnyere token Bearer) — upstream ga-ahụ naanị ihe ị tinyere, ọ bụghị igodo dị na ntọala. Nhazi na-ezighi ezi nwere ike ịkpata 401 ma ọ bụ mebie nkwenye njirimara upstream. Otu ahịrị maka nkụnye isi ọ bụla (dịka Authentication ọzọ maka ụfọdụ gateway). Debe òké n'elu uru ahụ ma ọ bụ lekwasị ya anya iji hụ nhụchalụ. A na-echekwa ya mgbe elekwasịghị ya anya, mgbe a pịrị n'èzí, ma ọ bụ mgbe emechiri panel a.

providers.onboardingCreateCustomCompatibleProvider: Mepụta onye na-eweta ọrụ ahaziri iche nke dakọtara
providers.onboardingCreateCustomCompatibleDescript: Ọkachamara a na-ebu ụzọ mepụta ọnụ onye na-eweta ọrụ, wee chekwaa ma nwalee njikọ API-key ya.
providers.onboardingProviderPrefixHint: A na-eji ya emepụta id onye na-eweta ọrụ a na-achịkwa.
providers.onboardingOAuthFlowDescription: OmniRoute ga-emepe usoro OAuth dị adị maka onye na-eweta ọrụ a. Mgbe ịbanyechara, ọkachamara ahụ ga-ebughachi njikọ echekwara ma mee otu ule njikọ ahụ peeji onye na-eweta ọrụ na-eme.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.agentrouter: Nweta kredit efu $200 na https://agentrouter.org/register — achọghị kaadị kredit.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.unorouter: Mepụta API key na https://unorouter.ai, wee mado ya ebe a dị ka Bearer token.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.agnes-cn: Jikọọ Agnes AI (China) site na API key e nyere maka api.agnes-ai.cn. Igodo sitere na apihub.agnes-ai.com agaghị arụ ọrụ.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.aimlapi: Akwụsịla ọkwa efu (2026) — AI/ML API na-akwụzi naanị dịka ojiji siri dị (ntinye ego kacha nta bụ $20); enweghị kredit efu na-emegharị kwa oge.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ai21: Kredit nnwale $10 mgbe ị debanyere aha (ọ na-adị irè ọnwa 3), achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.alibaba: Jikọọ Alibaba site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.alibaba-cn: Jikọọ Alibaba (China) site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bailian-coding-plan: Jikọọ Alibaba Coding Plan site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bedrock: Njikọ Bedrock nke e wuru n'ime ya: nchọpụta ụdịdị na-eji ụdị ntọala Bedrock na profaịlụ inference, ebe nkata na-eji Bedrock Runtime Converse/ConverseStream APIs nke mpaghara.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.anthropic: Jikọọ Anthropic site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ant-ling: Debanye aha ma mepụta API key na Ant Ling API console (https://chat.ant-ling.com/open), wee mado ya ebe a. OmniRoute na-ebuga okporo ụzọ nkata na https://api.ant-ling.com/v1/chat/completions; onye na-eweta ọrụ ahụ dakọtara na OpenAI ma na-enyekwa interface dakọtara na Anthropic.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.api-airforce: Nweta API key gị na https://panel.api.airforce — endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI dị na https://api.airforce/v1
onboardingProviderDescriptions.azure-ai: Foundry na-eji interface OpenAI v1, ebe aha deployment na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ụdịdị. OmniRoute na-ahazi URL akụrụngwa mgbọrọgwụ ka ha bụrụ endpoint nkata v1 na /models.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.azure-openai: Jiri Azure OpenAI API key gị. Base URL kwesịrị ịbụ endpoint akụrụngwa gị, dịka ọmụmaatụ https://my-resource.openai.azure.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bai: Bearer API key maka b.ai LLM gateway dakọtara na OpenAI (ọ dị iche na TheB.AI). Mepụta key na https://docs.b.ai, wee jiri https://api.b.ai/v1 dị ka Base URL dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qianfan: Jiri Qianfan API key sitere na Baidu AI Cloud. Endpoint ndabara bụ v2 dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.baseten: Kredit nnwale $30 n'efu maka GPU inference
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bazaarlink: Mepụta API key efu na https://bazaarlink.ai — ụdị 'auto:free' na-ebuga arịrịọ na inference na-enweghị ụgwọ. Ụdị niile na-eji usoro provider/model-name, dịka xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.black-forest-labs: Jiri igodo API jikọọ Black Forest Labs.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.blackbox: Ọkwa efu: nkata bụ isi na-akparaghị ókè tinyere Minimax-M2.5, achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bluesminds: Nweta igodo API gị na https://www.bluesminds.com — endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI dị na https://api.bluesminds.com/v1, yana kredit efu kwa ụbọchị. Ụdị VIP (Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) na-eji kredit pi.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.byteplus: Jiri igodo API jikọọ BytePlus ModelArk.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bytez: Kredit efu $1, a na-emegharị ya kwa izu 4
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cerebras: Kredit ndebanye aha $5 a na-enye otu ugboro (ọ dị irè ụbọchị 30); achọrọ usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ. Nke a abụghị ọkwa efu na-emegharị ugboro ugboro.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.charm-hyper: Mepụta igodo API na https://hyper.charm.land, wee mado ya ebe a dịka token Bearer.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chutes: Igodo Bearer API maka ọnụ ụzọ Chutes dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clarifai: Clarifai na-enye nkata, responses na /models dakọtara na OpenAI na /v2/ext/openai/v1. Ụdị ọhaneze/obodo na-achọkarị PAT; igodo e kenyere naanị otu app na-arụ ọrụ naanị maka akụrụngwa dị n'ime app ahụ.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cloudflare-ai: Ọ chọrọ API Token NA Account ID (a na-ahụ ya na dash.cloudflare.com)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clova-studio: CLOVA Studio (HyperCLOVA X) dakọtara na OpenAI na /v1/openai. OmniRoute na-enyocha /v1/openai/models ma na-eziga okporo ụzọ nkata na /v1/openai/chat/completions. Ọ na-eji host clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com dị ugbu a — a na-akwụsị iji endpoint ochie clovastudio.apigw.ntruss.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cohere: Nnwale efu: oku API 1,000 kwa ọnwa maka nnwale, achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.command-code: Mepụta ma ọ bụ detuo igodo API site na Command Code, wee mado ya ebe a dịka token Bearer.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.datarobot: Ọnụ ụzọ ndabara na-edepụta ụdị ndị na-arụ ọrụ site na /genai/llmgw/catalog/. A na-akwadokwa URL ntinye maka arịrịọ nkata ozugbo dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.deepinfra: Kredit ndebanye aha efu maka nnwale API na nyocha ụdị
onboardingProviderDescriptions.deepseek: Token 5M n'efu mgbe ị debanyere aha — achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dgrid: Mepụta igodo DGrid API na https://dgrid.ai, wee jiri https://api.dgrid.ai/v1 dịka URL ntọala dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dify: Nweta igodo API site na instance Dify gị.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dit: dit.ai (Distributed Intelligence Trade) bụ router/ọnụ ụzọ dakọtara na OpenAI nke nwere ọnụahịa na-agbanwe maka arịrịọ ọ bụla, na-enye /v1/chat/completions na https://api.dit.ai/v1. OmniRoute na-eji protocol OpenAI; nyocha mmefu/nchekwa dị na dashboard dit.ai.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.empower: Empower na-enye nkata dakọtara na OpenAI na https://app.empower.dev/api/v1, yana nkwado ịkpọ ngwá ọrụ na empower-functions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.factory: Nweta igodo Factory API gị na https://app.factory.ai/settings/api-keys, wee mado ya dịka token Bearer. Endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI dị na https://api.factory.ai/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.featherless-ai: Ọkwa efu dị — achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.fenayai: Igodo Bearer API maka ọnụ ụzọ FenayAI dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.fireworks: Kredit mmalite efu $1 mgbe ị debanyere aha maka nnwale API
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freeaiapikey: Proxy API e belatara ọnụahịa maka ụdị 40+ gụnyere GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen 3.5. Nweta igodo API gị na https://freeaiapikey.com/dashboard. URL ntọala: https://freeaiapikey.com/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freemodel-dev: Nweta kredit API efu $300 na https://freemodel.dev — achọghị ozi ịkwụ ụgwọ. Endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI. Ụdị GPT-5.4 na GPT-5.5 dị.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.friendliai: Ọkwa efu maka inference na-enweghị sava — achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gemini: Ọkwa efu site na Google AI Studio; anaghịzi ebipụta oke ojiji nke ụdị ọ bụla (lelee ibe oke ojiji na AI Studio) — achọghị kaadị kredit.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlab: Token nnweta onwe onye GitLab maka Code Suggestions API ọhaneze. Hazie URL ntọala nke gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị naghị eji gitlab.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlawb-gmi: Nweta igodo API gị site na dashboard Gitlawb Opengateway.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlawb: Nweta igodo API gị site na dashboard Gitlawb Opengateway.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.glm: Jikọọ GLM Coding site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.glm-cn: Jikọọ GLM Coding (China) site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.glmt: Profaịlụ GLM ahaziri tupu oge eruo nke nwere oke token dị elu, agbanyere ikike iche echiche, na ogologo oge nchere.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.getgoapi: Jikọọ GoAPI site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.groq: Atụmatụ efu: oke dị iche maka model ọ bụla (token 200K kwa ụbọchị maka model nkata ọ bụla; lee console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits maka RPM/RPD) — enweghị usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ echekwara.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.heroku: Jikọọ Heroku AI site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.huggingface: API Inference efu maka ọtụtụ puku model (Whisper, VITS, SDXL…)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.hyperbolic: Kredit nnwale $1-5 mgbe ị debanyere aha maka serverless inference
onboardingProviderDescriptions.watsonx: Ọnụ ụzọ model watsonx na-enye /chat/completions na /models dakọtara na OpenAI n'okpuru /ml/gateway/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.inception: Inception Labs dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1. mercury-2 bụ diffusion LLM (dLLM) mbụ na katalọgụ ahụ — ọ na-emepụta ihe ọsọ ugboro 5-10 karịa model autoregressive ndị yiri ya, ma nwee ọkpụkpọ ngwá ọrụ, json_mode, na nsonaazụ ahaziri ahazi.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.inference-net: Kredit efu $25 mgbe ị debanyere aha, gbakwunyere onyinye ego nyocha dịnụ
onboardingProviderDescriptions.internlm: Oke efu kwa ọnwa bụ ihe dị ka token ntinye 1M / token mmepụta 3M (ihe dị ka 10 RPM)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.jina-ai: Igodo Bearer API maka api.jina.ai (embeddings, rerank, classify, segment, search). Ọ bụghị kaadị Reader / r.jina.ai. Igodo dashboard na-ebute JINA_AI_API_KEY ụzọ.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.jina-reader: Igodo Bearer API maka naanị ntụgharị URL gaa na markdown site na r.jina.ai. Ọ naghị enye /v1/embeddings ma ọ bụ /v1/rerank. Otu token Jina ahụ nke Foundation API na-arụkwa ọrụ.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kenari: Kenari na-enye endpoint mmecha nkata dakọtara na OpenAI na https://kenari.id/v1/chat/completions, tinyere katalọgụ /v1/models na-arụ ọrụ ozugbo nke gụnyere Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi na ndị ọzọ. OmniRoute na-eji usoro OpenAI ma depụta model site na passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kie: Jikọọ KIE.AI site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kilo-gateway: Jikọọ Kilo Gateway site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kimi: Jikọọ Kimi site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kimi-coding-apikey: Jikọọ Kimi Coding (API Key) site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.lambda-ai: Jikọọ Lambda AI site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.laozhang: Jikọọ LaoZhang AI site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.llamagate: Jikọọ LlamaGate site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.llm7: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ na-enweghị igodo API (jiri 'unused' dị ka igodo). Nweta token efu na token.llm7.io maka oke dị elu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.longcat: N'efu: onyinye token 10M otu ugboro mgbe e debanyere akaụntụ ma mezue nkwenye KYC (LongCat-2.0). Ọ bụ naanị otu ugboro — ọ bụghị oke a na-enye ugboro ugboro kwa ụbọchị/kwa ọnwa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.maritalk: Jikọọ Maritalk site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.meta-llama: Jikọọ Meta Llama API site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.minimax-cn: Jikọọ Minimax (China) site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.minimax: Jikọọ Minimax Coding site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.mistral: Ọkwa Experiment efu: nnweta ụdị model niile nwere oke ọnụego, achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.modal: Modal na-enyekarị ngwa ndị ọrụ na-akwado n'onwe ha nke dakọtara na OpenAI na /v1. OmniRoute ga-enyocha /v1/models ma ziga okporo ụzọ nkata gaa na /v1/chat/completions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.modelscope: Ọkwa efu site na ModelScope API-Inference — a chọrọ akaụntụ Alibaba.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.moonshot: Jikọọ Kimi site na igodo API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nebius: Kredit nnwale ruru ~$1 mgbe ị debanyere aha maka nnwale API
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nlpcloud: NLP Cloud na-eji API chatbot nke ya kama OpenAI chat/completions. OmniRoute na-eme ka ozi OpenAI kwekọọ na input/context/history ma na-enye katalọgụ mpaghara nke ụdị chatbot a na-akwado.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nous-research: Nous na-enye /v1 nke dakọtara na OpenAI, yana nnukwu katalọgụ /models dị na sava dịpụrụ adịpụ. Endpoint /chat/completions chọrọ igodo API ziri ezi maka inference site na mmemme.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.novita: Kredit nnwale $0.50 mgbe ị debanyere aha (na-adị irè ihe dị ka otu afọ)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nscale: Kredit efu $5 mgbe ị debanyere aha maka nnwale inference
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nvidia: Nnweta dev efu: ~40 RPM, ụdị 70+ (Kimi K2.5, GLM 4.7, DeepSeek V3.2...)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.oci: OCI na-enye endpoint chat na responses ndị dakọtara na OpenAI. Project ID abụghị iwu na OmniRoute, mana enwere ike ịchọ ya maka Responses na usoro ọrụ agentic.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ollama-cloud: Jiri igodo API jikọọ Ollama Cloud.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openadapter: OpenAdapter na-enye endpoint chat completions dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.openadapter.in/v1/chat/completions, nke na-achịkọta ụdị open-source 70+ (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, Llama, Mistral, …). OmniRoute na-eji protokol OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.opencode-go: Jiri igodo API jikọọ OpenCode Go.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.opencode-zen: Jiri igodo API jikọọ OpenCode Zen.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openrouter: Ụdị efu na $0/token nwere suffix :free - 20 RPM / 200 RPD
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openvecta: Kredit efu mgbe ị debanyere aha maka inference dakọtara na OpenAI n'ofe LLMs, embeddings, na ụdị reasoning
onboardingProviderDescriptions.orcarouter: Mepụta igodo API (nke na-amalite na sk-orca-) na https://www.orcarouter.ai, wee mado ya dịka Bearer token. Endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI dị na https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ovhcloud: Jiri igodo API jikọọ OVHcloud AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.pioneer: Kredit ojiji efu $75 — achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.plamo: PLaMo dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.platform.preferredai.jp/v1. Preferred Networks wuru ya ma hazie ya nke ọma maka asụsụ Japanese. Akwụkwọ ndu ya kachasị n'asụsụ Japanese.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.poe: Poe na-enye chat na responses dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.poe.com/v1, yana nyocha nguzozi ego ejiri njirimara kwado na /usage/current_balance.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.pollinations: Ọkwa efu na-achọghị igodo: openai, openai-fast, openai-large, qwen-coder, mistral, deepseek, grok, gemini-flash-lite-3.1, perplexity-fast, perplexity-reasoning. Ụdị Premium (claude, gemini, midijourney) chọrọ igodo API Pollinations sitere na enter.pollinations.ai.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.publicai: Ọ chọrọ igodo API — kredit ndebanye aha otu ugboro, emesịa a na-akwụ ụgwọ
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qiniu: Mepụta igodo API inference Qiniu AI na https://portal.qiniu.com/ai-inference/api-key, wee mado ya ebe a dịka Bearer token. Endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI dị na https://api.qnaigc.com/v1, nke na-eji otu igodo eme proxy maka DeepSeek, Claude, Kimi na ndị ọzọ.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.reka: Reka Chat dakọtara na OpenAI na /v1. OmniRoute na-enyocha /v1/models ma na-ebuga okporo ụzọ chat na /v1/chat/completions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.requesty: Mepụta igodo API na https://app.requesty.ai, wee mado ya ebe a dịka Bearer token. Endpoint dakọtara na OpenAI dị na https://router.requesty.ai/v1, yana katalọgụ /v1/models a na-emelite ozugbo.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.runwayml: Mmepụta vidiyo Runway dabere n'ọrụ. OmniRoute na-eziga ọrụ text-to-video ma ọ bụ image-to-video, na-enyocha /v1/tasks/[id], ma na-ahazi nsonaazụ vidiyo emechara ka ha kwekọọ na response /v1/videos/generations yiri nke OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sambanova: Kredit $5 n'efu mgbe ị debanyere aha (ọ ga-adị irè ụbọchị 30), achọghị kaadị kredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.seekai: Mepụta igodo API na https://seekai.cc, wee mado ya ebe a dịka Bearer token. URL ntọala dakọtara na OpenAI: https://seekai.cc/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sap: Nchọpụta ụdị na-eji /v2/lm/scenarios/foundation-models/models na AI_API_URL. Arịrịọ chat na-eji deploymentUrl/chat/completions ma chọọ AI-Resource-Group.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sarvam: Sarvam AI dakọtara na OpenAI na /v1. OmniRoute na-enyocha /v1/models ma na-ebuga okporo ụzọ chat na /v1/chat/completions. A haziri ụdị ndị ahụ maka asụsụ Indic.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.scaleway: Token 1M n'efu maka akaụntụ ọhụrụ — kwekọrọ na EU/GDPR (Paris), Qwen3 235B & Llama 70B
onboardingProviderDescriptions.siliconflow: Kredit $1 n'efu tinyere ụdị ndị ga-adị n'efu mgbe niile ma e mesịa nkwenye njirimara
onboardingProviderDescriptions.snowflake: Jiri igodo API jikọọ Snowflake Cortex.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.stability-ai: Jikọọ Stability AI site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sumopod: SumoPod na-enye ebe njedebe mmezu nkata dakọtara na OpenAI na https://ai.sumopod.com/v1/chat/completions, tinyere katalọgụ /v1/models dị ndụ. OmniRoute na-eji protokol OpenAI ma depụta ụdị site na passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.suno: Mado kuki nnọkọ sitere na suno.ai (Clerk auth)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.synthetic: Jikọọ Synthetic site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.thebai: Bearer API key maka ọnụ ụzọ TheB.AI dakọtara na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.together: Jikọọ Together AI site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.tokenrouter: TokenRouter na-enye ebe njedebe mmezu nkata dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1/chat/completions, tinyere katalọgụ /v1/models na-arụ ọrụ. OmniRoute na-eji protokol OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.topaz: Jikọọ Topaz site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.typhoon: Typhoon dakọtara na OpenAI na /v1. SCB 10X (Thailand) wuru ya; typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct bụ ụdị na-ebute asụsụ Thai ụzọ ma na-akwado ọtụtụ asụsụ.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.udio: Mado kuki nnọkọ sitere na udio.com (Supabase auth)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.uncloseai: Achọghị auth. API na-anabata eriri ọ bụla na-abụghị efu dịka key maka njirimara.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.upstage: Jikọọ Upstage site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.v0-vercel: Jikọọ v0 (Vercel) site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.venice: Jikọọ Venice.ai site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vercel-ai-gateway: Jikọọ Vercel AI Gateway site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vertex: Nye Service Account JSON ma ọ bụ OAuth access_token
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vertex-partner: Nye otu Service Account JSON ahụ e ji maka ụdị ndị mmekọ Vertex AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.volcengine: Jikọọ Volcengine site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.voyage-ai: Bearer API key maka API embeddings na rerank nke Voyage AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.wandb: Jikọọ Weights & Biases Inference site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.writer: Writer Palmyra dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.writer.com/v1. palmyra-x5 na-enye windo context nwere ikike token 1M.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.x5lab: X5Lab na-enye ebe njedebe mmezu nkata dakọtara na OpenAI na https://api.x5lab.dev/v1/chat/completions, tinyere katalọgụ /v1/models dị ndụ. OmniRoute na-eji protokol OpenAI ma depụta ụdị site na passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.xai: Jikọọ xAI (Grok) site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.xiaomi-mimo: Jikọọ Xiaomi MiMo site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.zenmux: ZenMux na-enye ebe njedebe mmezu nkata dakọtara na OpenAI na /api/v1/chat/completions, tinyere ọnụ njikọ protokol Anthropic Messages (/api/anthropic/v1/messages) na Google Gemini (/api/vertex-ai). OmniRoute na-eji protokol OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.galadriel: Jikọọ Galadriel site na API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.predibase: Kredit nnwale efu $25 (ọ dị irè ụbọchị 30)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chenzk: Ọnụ ụzọ dakọtara na OpenAI nwere katalọgụ ụdị a na-emelite ozugbo na chenzk.top.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freetheai: Ọnụ ụzọ efu dakọtara na OpenAI nke na-akwado ụdị passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-gemini: Ọnụ ụzọ g4f.space dị anya gaa Gemini. Nnweta na-enweghị njirimara chọrọ kredit proof-of-work sitere na g4f.dev/chat ma ọ bụ API key onye otu sitere na g4f.dev/members.html; oke na-adị iche.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-groq: Ọnụ ụzọ g4f.space dị anya gaa Groq. Nnweta na-enweghị njirimara chọrọ kredit proof-of-work sitere na g4f.dev/chat ma ọ bụ API key onye otu sitere na g4f.dev/members.html; oke na-adị iche.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-nvidia: Ọnụ ụzọ g4f.space dị anya gaa NVIDIA NIM. Nnweta na-enweghị njirimara chọrọ kredit proof-of-work sitere na g4f.dev/chat ma ọ bụ API key onye otu sitere na g4f.dev/members.html; oke na-adị iche.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-ollama: Ọnụ ụzọ g4f.space dị anya gaa Ollama. Nnweta na-enweghị njirimara chọrọ kredit proof-of-work sitere na g4f.dev/chat ma ọ bụ API key onye otu sitere na g4f.dev/members.html; oke na-adị iche.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-pollinations: Ọnụ ụzọ g4f.space dị anya gaa Pollinations. Nnweta na-enweghị njirimara chọrọ kredit proof-of-work sitere na g4f.dev/chat ma ọ bụ API key onye otu sitere na g4f.dev/members.html; oke na-adị iche.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.segmind: Jiri ụdị ndị Segmind kwadoro mepụta onyonyo na vidiyo.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.amazon-q: Ọ na-eji otu AWS Builder ID ahụ ma ọ bụ usoro refresh-token e bubatara dịka Kiro, mana ọ na-edobe njikọ Amazon Q iche.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.agy: Bubata nbanye Antigravity CLI (`agy`) gị (mado/bulite faịlụ token ya), chọpụta nbanye CLI dị na mpaghara na-akpaghị aka, ma ọ bụ jiri Google banye. Ọ na-ekekọrịta backend Antigravity (gụnyere ụdị Claude).

onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlab-duo: Ngwa OAuth nwere scopes ai_features + read_user. Hazie GITLAB_DUO_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID na, ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ, GITLAB_DUO_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET n’instance OmniRoute a.

providers.webSessionGuideTitle: Otu esi enweta credential nnọkọ ahụ
providers.webSessionGuideIntro: {provider} na-eji nnọkọ webụ ihe nchọgharị kama igodo API.
providers.webSessionGuideStep2: Mepee ngwa ndị nrụpụta nke ihe nchọgharị ma nyochaa arịrịọ nke ngwa webụ mere.
providers.webSessionGuideStep2Fast: Ụzọ ngwa ngwa: wụnye mgbakwunye Cookie Editor (chromewebstore.google.com → Cookie Editor), mepee ya na taabụ {provider}, chọta {credential} (họrọ akụkụ niile e nyere nọmba ma ọ bụrụ na e kewara ya), tọọ usoro mbupụ ka ọ bụrụ “Cookie header”, wee pịa Export → Copy.
providers.webSessionGuideStep3: Detuo credential achọrọ site na ngalaba nke provider n’onwe ya. Maka kuki, detuo naanị uru nkụnyeisi Cookie ma hapụ Cookie:.
providers.webSessionGuideStep3Manual: Ụzọ aka: mepee ngwa ndị nrụpụta nke ihe nchọgharị (F12 → Network), mee ka ibe ahụ dị ọhụrụ, mepee arịrịọ e mere mgbe abanyechara, wee detuo uru nkụnyeisi Cookie site na Request Headers — hapụ prefix Cookie:.
providers.webSessionGuideStep4: Mado ya ebe a wee lelee njikọ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ọ kwụsị ịrụ ọrụ, banye ọzọ ma jiri uru ọhụrụ dochie ya.

settings.title: Ntọala
settings.routingSettingsIntro: Na-achịkwa otu esi eduzi, gbanwee, ma ziga arịrịọ gị nye ndị na-eweta AI.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphContainsDesc: Na-ewepụ paragraf ọ bụla (ngọngọ ederede e kewara site n'ahịrị efu) dị n'ime system prompt nke ederede ya nwere NKE Ọ BỤLA n'ime obere eriri edepụtara. Jiri ya wepụ akara njirimara ndị ahịa nke ndị ọzọ dịka 'github.com/anomalyco/opencode' ma ọ bụ 'docs.openwebui.com' nke classifier Anthropic na-akanye.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphStartsWithDesc: Na-ewepụ paragraf ọ bụla nke NA-AMALITE NA otu n'ime prefixes edepụtara. Jiri ya maka ahịrị njirimara dịka 'You are OpenCode' ma ọ bụ 'You are Open WebUI' nke na-ekwupụta onye ahịa na-akpọ oku.
settings.routingOpReplaceTextDesc: Na-eji obere eriri literal ọzọ dochie obere eriri literal. Jiri ya maka nkebiokwu ndị amaara na-akpalite ihe — dịka ịgbanwe 'Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:' ka ọ bụrụ 'Environment context you are running in:' (nkebiokwu mkpali e gosipụtara na ọ na-arụ ọrụ site na nnwale).
settings.routingOpReplaceRegexDesc: Na-edochie ederede dabara na regular expression. Jiri ya mgbe ịchọrọ patterns (character classes, optional whitespace, anchors) kama obere eriri literal. A na-ejide pattern e mebiri emebi n'oge runtime mgbe op na-arụ ọrụ.
settings.routingOpDropBlockContainsDesc: Na-ewepụ blọk sistem DUM (ọ bụghị naanị paragraf) nke ederede ha nwere nke ọ bụla n'ime obere eriri ndị edepụtara. Jiri ya mgbe blọk dum nwere akara njirimara ma ịchọrọ iwepụ ya — dịka ọmụmaatụ, nkọwa MCP-server etinyere.
settings.routingOpPrependSystemBlockDesc: Na-etinye blọk ederede ọhụrụ n'IHU usoro sistem. Jiri ya tinye njirimara SDK 'You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.' nke ihe nhazi Anthropic na-atụ anya ya.
settings.routingOpAppendSystemBlockDesc: Na-etinye blọk ederede ọhụrụ na NGWỤCHA usoro sistem. Jiri ya maka mgbakwunye ịchọ mma ndị na-adịghị mkpa ịnọ na ọnọdụ [0].
settings.routingOpInjectBillingHeaderDesc: Na-etinye blọk ederede pụrụ iche 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cc_entrypoint=...; cch=...;' n'ihu, nke ihe nhazi Anthropic na-enyocha. A chọrọ ya maka endpoint relay àkwà mmiri CC; maka provider claude nke mbụ, OmniRoute etinyelarị ahịrị billing nke ya, ya mere op a anaghị adịkarị mkpa n'ebe ahụ.
settings.routingOpObfuscateWordsDesc: Na-etinye mkpụrụedemede Zero-Width-Joiner mgbe mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke okwu ọ bụla edepụtara gasịrị, ka 'opencode' wee ghọọ 'opencode'. Ọ na-adị otu ihe ahụ mgbe mmadụ gụrụ ya, mana ọ na-agafe ndakọrịta okwu nke ihe nhazi. Ọ na-elekwasị anya na blọk sistem, ozi user/assistant, na nkọwa tool.
settings.routingNeedlesHint: Ndepụta obere eriri. Paragraf ga-adakọ ma ọ bụrụ na o nwere NKE Ọ BỤLA n'ime ha. Tinye otu n'ahịrị ọ bụla site na 'Add entry'.
settings.routingPrefixesHint: Ndepụta eriri. Paragraf ga-adakọ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ malitere na nke ọ bụla n'ime ha (a na-ewepụ oghere dị n'ihu tupu ndakọrịta).
settings.routingCaseSensitiveHint: Mgbe ọ dị ON, 'OpenCode' na 'opencode' bụ eriri dị iche. Mgbe ọ dị OFF (ndabara), ntụnyere anaghị ele nnukwu na obere mkpụrụedemede anya.
settings.routingMatchLiteralHint: Obere eriri literal kpọmkwem a ga-achọta. Enweghị syntax regex — a na-ewere mkpụrụedemede pụrụ iche dịka . * ? dịka onwe ha.
settings.routingReplacementTextHint: Eriri nnọchi. Hapụ ya oghere iji hichapụ ihe dakọtara. Nsonaazụ ahụ na-echekwa ederede gbara ya gburugburu.
settings.routingAllOccurrencesHint: Mgbe ọ dị ON (ndabara), a na-edochi ihe niile pụtara. Mgbe ọ dị OFF, ọ bụ naanị ndakọrịta mbụ ka a na-edochi.
settings.routingPatternHint: Isi regex JavaScript. Ekechila ya na slash — jiri naanị 'foo(.*)bar'. Server ga-ajụ pattern ndị na-enweghị ike ịkọmpailụ.
settings.routingRegexFlagsHint: Flag regex JavaScript (g = ndakọrịta niile, i = anaghị ele nnukwu na obere mkpụrụedemede anya, s = dot na-adakọ na ahịrị ọhụrụ, m = ọtụtụ ahịrị). Ndabara bụ 'g'.
settings.routingBlockTextHint: Ederede zuru ezu nke blọk sistem ọhụrụ. Jiri eriri nkịtị; blọk sistem na-echekwa naanị ederede.
settings.routingIdempotencyKeyHint: Nhọrọ. Ọ bụrụ na edobere ya, op ahụ ga-amafere mgbe blọk nke ederede ya malitere na key a dịlarị. Nke a na-egbochi itinye otu ihe n'ihu ugboro abụọ mgbe a na-anwalegharị.

contextCombos.explanationPreview: Nhụchalụ: na-egosi injin ndị profaịlụ na-arụ ọrụ na-agba, n'usoro.
contextCombos.activeProfileDescription: Họrọ profaịlụ mkpakọ ga-arụ ọrụ n'ebe niile — Ndabara e nwetara site na panel ma ọ bụ ngwakọta nwere aha echekwara.

omniglyph.description: Mkpakọ ọnọdụ dịka onyonyo. Ọ na-egosipụta system prompt, akwụkwọ ngwaọrụ, na akụkọ jupụtara dịka ibe PNG kọmpat maka ụzọ Claude Fable 5 a tụrụ. Ngwugwu OmniGlyph e bipụtara na-enyekwa transformers GPT 5.6 native, mana OmniRoute na-emechi ụzọ ndị ahụ ma ha daa ruo mgbe e nwere nkwenye izi ezi na nkwenye ọgụgụ sitere n'aka provider.

model.label: Ụdị
model.why: Naanị ụzọ Fable 5 a tụrụ ka agbanyere na OmniRoute. Ngwugwu ahụ na-akwado GPT 5.6 n'usoro nhazi, mana a ka na-egbochi ya ruo mgbe nkwenye provider ya dị; ezinụlọ ndị a na-enyochabeghị dịka Grok ga-anọgide na-eji naanị ederede.

transport.label: Nnyefe
transport.why: Aggregators nwere ike ịmegharị sample onyonyo ma mebie ikike ịgụ ya — naanị ụzọ provider kpọmkwem ka a na-ewere dị ka nke ziri ezi.

format.label: Ụdị
format.why: Body ahụ ga-adaba na wire nke provider: Claude Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, ma ọ bụ native OpenAI Responses input[].

profitable.label: Nwere uru
profitable.why: Gate ọnụ ahịa 28px-patch kpọmkwem na-ekpebi maka request ọ bụla; ederede nta ma ọ bụ nke na-adịghị jupụta ga-agafe n'enweghị mgbanwe.

omniglyph.enableDescription: Ọ na-agba ikpeazụ n'ime stack mgbe engine ederede sachara request ahụ, na-eji wire native nke provider; a na-akpakọ request OpenAI Chat/Responses mgbe ntụgharị gasịrị ka e wee chekwaa ọdịdị ha. Ọ na-agbakwa naanị ya site na mode omniglyph. Nke a bụ nlele mbụ ma ọ ka gbanyụrụ na ndabara ruo mgbe nnwale site na mbido ruo na njedebe zuru ezu.
omniglyph.profileDescription: Profaịlụ bụ oke kachasị, ọ bụghị oke kacha nta: enweghị ike iji mgbanwe nke otu nzọụkwụ megharịa profaịlụ siri ike karịa. Dị ka e tụrụ na codebase a: site na coding-safe ma ọ bụ balanced, nnọkọ na-enweghị akụkọ ihe mere eme ọ chịkọbara anaghị akpakọta ihe ọ bụla, n’ihi na ha abụọ na-ebuli oke mkpụrụedemede kacha nta ma na-edobe system prompt, tool schemas na tool results n’ụdị mbụ ha.

aggressive.label: Siri ike (ndabara)
aggressive.description: Amụma e ji tụọ nnata ndị e bipụtara. Na-eme system prompt, akwụkwọ nkọwa tool na akụkọ ihe mere eme jupụtara n’ihe ka ha bụrụ onyonyo.

balanced.label: Ziri ezi n’etiti
balanced.description: Na-edobe ọnọdụ dị ugbu a n’ụdị mbụ ya ma na-echekwa mgbanwe mkparịta ụka 8 ikpeazụ; ọ na-akpakọta naanị akụkọ ochie emechiri emechi.

codingSafe.label: Nchekwa maka ide koodu
codingSafe.description: Na-edobe ikike, tool schemas na mmepụta tool dị ugbu a n’ụdị mbụ ha, ma na-echekwa mgbanwe mkparịta ụka 12 ikpeazụ. Ọ naghị akpakọta ihe ọ bụla ruo mgbe nnọkọ ahụ chịkọbara akụkọ ihe mere eme.

passthrough.label: Nyefee ozugbo
passthrough.description: Na-eduzi arịrịọ na-agbanweghị ya. A na-amafere engine ahụ, a na-eziga arịrịọ ahụ n’ebughị ụzọ metụ ya aka.

translator.title: Onye Ntụgharị
translator.metaDescription: Chọpụta nsogbu, nwalee, ma gosipụta ntụgharị usoro API n’etiti ndị na-eweta ọrụ
translator.modeDescriptionPlayground: Tapawa ahụ arịrịọ API ọ bụla ma hụ ka OmniRoute si atụgharị ya n’etiti usoro ndị na-eweta ọrụ (OpenAI ↔ Claude ↔ Gemini ↔ Responses API)
translator.modeDescriptionChatTester: Zipụ ezigbo arịrịọ nkata site na OmniRoute ma nyochaa usoro njem zuru ezu: ntinye, arịrịọ a tụgharịrị, nzaghachi onye na-eweta ọrụ, na mmepụta a tụgharịrị.
translator.modeDescriptionTestBench: Mee ọnọdụ ule ndị akọwapụtara tupu oge eruo ma tulee ndakọrịta n’etiti ndị na-eweta ọrụ na ụdị.
translator.modeDescriptionLiveMonitor: Lelee ihe omume ntụgharị ozugbo ka arịrịọ na-agafe na OmniRoute.
translator.modeDescriptionFallback: Chọpụta ma dozie nsogbu, nwalee, ma jiri eserese gosipụta ka OmniRoute si atụgharị arịrịọ API n’etiti ndị na-eweta ọrụ.
translator.recentTranslations: Ntụgharị Ndị Mere Nso Nso A
translator.eventsAppearHint: Ihe omume ntụgharị ga-apụta ebe a ka arịrịọ na-agafe na OmniRoute. Jiri nke ọ bụla n’ime ụzọ ndị a mepụta ihe omume:
translator.inMemoryNote: Rịba ama: A na-echekwa ihe omume na ebe nchekwa nwa oge, a ga-ehichapụkwa ha mgbe sava malitegharịrị.
translator.formatConverterDescription: Tapawa ma ọ bụ pịnye ahụ arịrịọ JSON. Onye ntụgharị ga-achọpụta usoro isi mmalite n’onwe ya ma gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ usoro ebumnuche. Jiri nke a chọpụta ma dozie otu OmniRoute si atụgharị arịrịọ n’etiti usoro (OpenAI ↔ Claude ↔ Gemini ↔ Responses API).
translator.featureReasoningCacheDesc: Ọ na-etinyeghachi reasoning_content echekwara maka ụdị ndị na-eji ọnọdụ iche echiche (DeepSeek V4, Kimi K2, Qwen) mgbe ndị ahịa etinyeghị ya n'akụkọ mkparịta ụka.
translator.featureSchemaCoercionDesc: Na-edozi schema ngwaọrụ ndị mebiri emebi: na-agbakwunye additionalProperties ndị na-efu, na-eme ka nkọwa ndị toro ogologo dị ọcha, ma na-ahazi ihe ndị dị n'ime ibe ha.
translator.featureRoleNormalizationDesc: Na-atụgharị developer→system maka ebumnuche ndị na-abụghị OpenAI. Na-atụgharị system→user maka ụdị ndị na-akwadoghị ọrụ system.
translator.featureToolCallIdsDesc: Na-emepụta ID tool_call pụrụ iche mgbe ha na-efu. Na-ahazi ha n'ụdị mkpụrụakara 9 maka ndị na-eweta ọrụ dịka Mistral.
translator.featureMissingToolResponseDesc: Na-etinye ozi tool_result efu mgbe ndị ahịa zitere tool_calls na-enweghị nzaghachi kwekọrọ.
translator.featureThinkingBudgetDesc: Njikwa dị n'ọkwa proxy maka mpaghara arịrịọ echiche/ntụgharị uche: passthrough (onye ahịa na-achịkwa), auto (wepụ paramita echiche niile), custom (oke a kapịrị ọnụ), ma ọ bụ adaptive (gbanwee dịka mgbagwoju anya si dị). Ọ nọọrọ onwe ya na mkpakọ na routing. Ọ naghị emeghe ọdịnaya ntụgharị uche e ji izo ya ezo.
translator.featureDirectPathsDesc: Ụfọdụ ụzọ usoro abụọ (Claude→Gemini) nwere ndị ntụgharị kpọmkwem na-agafeghị OpenAI hub, nke na-emepụta nsonaazụ ziri ezi karịa.
translator.featureImageMappingDesc: Na-atụgharị ụkpụrụ akụkụ onyonyo n'etiti usoro API (dịka, ọkwa nkọwa OpenAI → akụkụ Gemini).
translator.inputPlaceholder: Tapawa ahụ arịrịọ ebe a ma ọ bụ họrọ ndebiri n'okpuru...
translator.templateLoadHint: Ndebiri ahụ na-ebu arịrịọ ahụ n'ụdị {format}. Gbanwee Usoro Isi Iyi iji buo ya n'ụdị dị iche.
translator.testBenchDescription: Mee ọnọdụ ule akọwapụtara tupu oge eruo (Mkparịta ụka Dị Mfe, Ịkpọ Ngwaọrụ, wdg.) iji nyochaa ntụgharị na ndakọrịta onye na-eweta ọrụ. Họrọ usoro isi iyi na onye na-eweta ọrụ ezubere iche, wee mee ule niile ka ịhụ pasent ndakọrịta. Jiri nke a chọpụta atụmatụ ndị na-arụ ọrụ n'ofe ndị na-eweta ọrụ.

docs.docsHeroDescription: Ọnụ ụzọ AI maka LLM sitere n’aka ọtụtụ ndị na-eweta ọrụ. Otu endpoint maka OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, na ndị na-eweta ọrụ 20+ ọzọ.

docs.quickStartStep2Text: Gaa na Endpoint -> Registered Keys. Mepụta otu igodo maka gburugburu ọ bụla.
docs.quickStartStep3Text: Tinye akaụntụ ndị na-eweta ọrụ site na nbanye OAuth, igodo API, ma ọ bụ njikọ akpaaka nke ọkwa efu.

docs.deploySetupText: Nduzi nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ maka nrụnye, nhazi gburugburu, na ịgba OmniRoute nke mbụ.
docs.deployElectronText: Gbaa OmniRoute dịka ngwa desktọpụ e wuru maka Windows, macOS, na Linux.
docs.deployDockerText: Mbugharị n'ime kọntena site na Docker Compose; dị njikere maka sistemụ mmepụta na Kubernetes.
docs.deployVmText: Gbaa ya n’onwe gị na Linux VM ọ bụla. Ọ gụnyere unit systemd, ntụgharị log, na ngwaọrụ ndabere.
docs.deployFlyText: Bugharịa ya na edge runtime nke Fly.io site na otu fly.toml na otu iwu mbugharị.
docs.deployPwaText: Wụnye OmniRoute dịka Progressive Web App na Android, iOS, na ihe nchọgharị desktọpụ.
docs.deployTermuxText: Rụọ OmniRoute na-enweghị interface na Android site na Termux. Nweta dashboard site na ihe nchọgharị ekwentị gị.
docs.featureRoutingTitle: Nduzi n’Etiti Ọtụtụ Ndị Na-eweta Ọrụ
docs.featureRoutingText: Duzie arịrịọ gaa na ndị na-eweta AI 30+ site n’otu endpoint kwekọrọ na OpenAI. Ọ na-akwado API nkata, nzaghachi, ọdịyo, na onyonyo.
docs.featureCombosText: Mepụta ngwakọta ụdị nwere usoro ndabere na atụmatụ nhazite ibu: round-robin, mkpa, enweghị usoro, nke e ji mee ihe kacha nta, na nke ahaziri iji belata ọnụ ahịa.
docs.featureUsageText: Ngụ token ozugbo, mgbakọ ọnụ ahịa maka onye na-eweta ọrụ/ụdị ọ bụla, na nkọwa ojiji zuru ezu dịka igodo API na akaụntụ si dị.
docs.featureAnalyticsText: Nnyocha anya site na eserese maka arịrịọ, token, njehie, oge nzaghachi, ụgwọ, na ewu ewu nke ụdị ka oge na-aga.
docs.featureHealthText: Nnyocha ahụike ozugbo, ọnọdụ ndị na-eweta ọrụ, ọnọdụ circuit breaker, na nchọpụta akpaka nke oke ọnụego yana exponential backoff.
docs.featureCliText: Jikwaa nhazi IDE, bupụ/bubata nkwado ndabere, chọpụta profaịlụ Codex, ma hazie ntọala site na dashboard.
docs.featureSecurityText: Nkwenye njirimara site na API key, nzacha IP, nchedo megide prompt injection, iwu ngalaba, njikwa nnọkọ, na ndekọ nyocha.
docs.featureCloudSyncText: Mekọrịta nhazi gị na Cloudflare Workers maka nnweta site n'ebe dị anya, yana nzere ezoro ezo na failover akpaka.

docs.clientWindsurfBullet2: Tụọ model aka na `/v1/chat/completions` maka okporo ụzọ izugbe ma debe `/v1/responses` maka usoro ụdị Codex.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet3: Jiri Dashboard -> CLI Tools maka ntuziaka nhazi Windsurf dị njikere.
docs.clientClineBullet1: Cline na-arụ ọrụ kacha mma mgbe e depụtara nganiihu provider/model nke ọma ka router ghara ịkọ backend ahụ n'echiche.
docs.clientClineBullet2: Jiri `/v1/chat/completions` maka model izugbe ma jiri otu OmniRoute base URL ahụ ọzọ n'ofe akaụntụ dị iche iche.
docs.clientClineBullet3: Jiri dashboard Providers kwado OAuth/API key tupu ịchọpụta nsogbu runtime Cline.
docs.clientKimiBullet1: Jiri OmniRoute dịka base URL kwụsiri ike mgbe ị na-agbanwe akaụntụ ma ọ bụ ngwakọta provider ndị dị n'okpuru ya.
docs.clientKimiBullet2: Họrọ model nwere nganiihu na usoro coding ka fallback na ndekọ audit nọgide bụrụ ihe doro anya.
docs.clientKimiBullet3: Jiri `/v1/responses` mgbe ịchọrọ routing ụdị Responses nke mbụ maka clients na-eji tools.
docs.protocolsDescription: OmniRoute na-enye protocols arụmọrụ abụọ na mgbakwunye na APIs dakọtara na OpenAI: MCP maka imezu tools na A2A maka usoro ọrụ agent-na-agent.
docs.protocolMcpDesc: Jiri MCP site na stdio ka clients nwee ike ịchọpụta ma kpọọ tools OmniRoute, ebe a na-ahụkwa audit.
docs.protocolMcpStep2: Tụọ MCP client gị aka na stdio transport.
docs.protocolA2aDesc: Jiri A2A JSON-RPC zipu tasks n'ụzọ synchronous ma ọ bụ site na SSE streaming.
docs.protocolA2aStep2: Zipu arịrịọ `message/send` ma ọ bụ `message/stream` na `POST /a2a`.
docs.protocolA2aStep3: Jikwaa usoro ndụ task site na `tasks/get` na `tasks/cancel`.
docs.protocolTroubleshooting1: Ọ bụrụ na ọnọdụ MCP bụ offline, chọpụta na process stdio na-arụ ọrụ nakwa na a na-emelite heartbeat file.
docs.protocolTroubleshooting2: Ọ bụrụ na tasks A2A anọgide na `working`, nyochaa `/api/a2a/tasks/:id` na stream events maka terminal state.

legal.privacySection1Text: E mere OmniRoute ka ọ bụrụ ngwa na-ebute mpaghara ụzọ. Nhazi na nchekwa data niile na-eme kpamkpam na kọmputa gị. Enweghị sava etiti na-anakọta ozi gị.

legal.privacySection3Text: OmniRoute anaghị anakọta telemetry, nyocha ojiji, ma ọ bụ akụkọ ndakpọ. A naghị ezitere anyị ma ọ bụ ndị ọzọ data ọ bụla. Ụkpụrụ ojiji gị, oku API, na nhazi gị na-anọgide bụrụ nke nzuzo kpamkpam.
legal.privacySection4Title: 4. Ndị Na-eweta AI nke Ndị Ọzọ
legal.privacySection4Text: Mgbe ị na-ezipụ oku API site na OmniRoute, a na-ebuga arịrịọ gị n'aka ndị na-eweta AI ị haziri (dịka ọmụmaatụ: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). Ndị na-eweta ọrụ ndị a nwere amụma nzuzo nke ha na-achịkwa otu ha si ejikwa data gị. Biko lelee:
legal.privacySection5Text: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanye atụmatụ mmekọrịta igwe ojii nke bụ nhọrọ, enwere ike iziga nhazi ndị na-eweta ọrụ na igodo API na njedebe igwe ojii ahaziri. A gbanyụrụ atụmatụ a na ndabara, ọ na-achọkwa ka i jiri aka gị kwenye isonye.
legal.privacyLoggingIntro: Enwere ike ịhazi ndekọ arịrịọ site na ntọala dashboard. Ị nwere ike:
legal.privacySection7TextStart: Ebe ọ bụ na a na-echekwa data niile na mpaghara, ị nwere njikwa zuru oke. Ị nwere ike ihichapụ data gị n'oge ọ bụla site n'iwepụ
legal.privacySection7TextEnd: direktori ahụ ma ọ bụ site n'iji atụmatụ ndabere na mweghachi nchekwa data dị na dashboard.
legal.termsSection1Text: OmniRoute bụ rawụta proxy AI API nke na-ebute ọrụ mpaghara ụzọ ma na-arụ ọrụ kpamkpam na kọmputa gị. Ọ na-ebugharị arịrịọ gaa na ọtụtụ ndị na-eweta AI site na nkesa ibu ọrụ, ịgafe na nke ọzọ mgbe otu dara, na nsuso ojiji.
legal.termsResponsibilityApiKeys: Ọ bụ naanị gị ka ọrụ ijikwa igodo API na nzere nke gị maka ndị na-eweta AI nke ndị ọzọ (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, wdg.) dịịrị.
legal.termsResponsibilityCompliance: Ị ga-agbasorịrị usoro ojiji nke onye na-eweta AI ọ bụla nke ị na-enweta API ya site na OmniRoute.
legal.termsResponsibilitySecurity: Ọ bụ gị ka ọrụ nchekwa nke nrụnye OmniRoute dị na kọmputa gị dịịrị, gụnyere ịtọ okwuntughe na igbochi ohere netwọkụ.
legal.termsSection3Text: OmniRoute na-arụ ọrụ dịka onye nnọchiteanya etiti. A na-atụgharị oku API e zigara OmniRoute ma bufee ha n'aka ndị na-eweta AI ị haziri. OmniRoute anaghị agbanwe ọdịnaya arịrịọ ma ọ bụ nzaghachi gị, ewezuga ntụgharị protokol dị mkpa.
legal.termsDataStoredLocally: A na-echekwa data niile na kọmputa gị n'ime ọdụ data SQLite.
legal.termsNoTransmission: OmniRoute anaghị eziga data ọ bụla na sava ndị dị n'èzí, ọ gwụla ma i mere ka atụmatụ mmekọrịta igwe ojii rụọ ọrụ n'ụzọ doro anya.

legal.termsSection5Text: A na-enye OmniRoute "dị ka ọ dị" n'enweghị akwụkwọ nkwa ọ bụla. Anyị anaghị aza maka ụgwọ ọ bụla sitere n'iji API, nkwụsị ọrụ, ma ọ bụ mfu data. Na-edobe nnomi ndabere nke nhazi gị mgbe niile.
legal.termsSection6Text: OmniRoute bụ ngwanrọ mepere emepe. Ị nweere onwe gị inyocha, ịgbanwe, na ikesa ya dịka usoro ikike ya siri dị.

oauthModal.googleLoopbackWhatHappens: Google na-ewepụta koodu ikike naanị mgbe ihe nchọgharị nke kwadoro nbanye nwere ike iru {redirectUri}. N'ebe a, adreesị ahụ na-ezo aka na kọmputa a, ọ bụghị na sava OmniRoute — ya mere ihuenyo nkwenye na-akwụsị kama ibugharị, ọ nweghịkwa URL callback a ga-edepụta.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackRecommended: Ihe akwadoro — mee nke a na kọmputa gị, wee mado nsonaazụ ya n'okpuru:
oauthModal.googleLoopbackHelperNote: Ọ na-emepe nkwenye Google na kọmputa gị (ebe 127.0.0.1 na-arụ ọrụ) ma bipụta blob omniroute-cred-v1.… dị n'otu ahịrị. Mado blob ahụ n'oghere Nzọụkwụ 2 dị n'okpuru — ọ na-anabata blob nzere yana URL callback.

oauthModal.googleLoopbackHeadlessAlt: Maka ojiji headless zuru oke na-enweghị callback mpaghara ọ bụla, hazie nzere Google OAuth nke gị tinyere URL ntọala ọha.
oauthModal.remoteAccessInfo: Nnweta ime anya: Ebe ị na-enweta OmniRoute site n'ebe dị anya, mgbe inye ikike gachara, ị ga-ahụ ibe njehie (ahụghị localhost). Nke a bụ ihe nkịtị — naanị depụta URL zuru ezu dị n'ogwe adreesị ihe nchọgharị gị ma mado ya n'okpuru.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchTitle: Enweghị ike mezue nbanye site na adreesị a
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchExplanation: Mgbe ị kwadoro nbanye ahụ, {providerName} na-ezighachi ihe nchọgharị mgbe niile na {redirectUri}. Adreesị ahụ na-ezo aka na kọmputa na-arụ ihe nchọgharị a, ọ bụghị na sava OmniRoute — ya mere koodu ikike anaghị erute OmniRoute, onye na-eweta ọrụ ahụ wee ghara imezu nbanye na-egosighị njehie.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep1: Na kọmputa a, mepee terminal ma malite SSH tunnel gaa na sava OmniRoute:
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep1Note: Jiri aha njirimara SSH gị dochie {userPlaceholder}. Hapụ terminal a ka ọ ghe oghe ruo mgbe njikọ ahụ gosiri na ọ na-arụ ọrụ — a chọrọ port abụọ ahụ: otu na-enye dashboard, nke ọzọ na-anata callback.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep2: N'ihe nchọgharị a, mepee OmniRoute ọzọ site na tunnel ahụ:
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep3: Mgbe ahụ, jikọọ {providerName} ọzọ site na taabụ ọhụrụ ahụ. Callback ahụ ga-erute sava ugbu a, nbanye ahụ wee mezue nke ọma.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchAlternative: Ị nweghị ohere SSH? Ọ bụrụ na onye na-eweta ọrụ a nwere taabụ mbubata token, jiri token jikọọ kama — ụzọ ahụ anaghị eji loopback callback.

quotaShare.conceptTitle: Otu Quota Share si arụ ọrụ
quotaShare.conceptIntro: Quota Share na-ekewa oke onye na-eweta ọrụ n'etiti ọtụtụ igodo API site na nkekọrịta nha anya nke na-eji ikike niile dị: igodo ọ bụla na-enweta akụkụ kwekọrọ na ya, mana ọ nwere ike ịgbaziri site na nguzo efu n'agafeghị oke zuru ụwa ọnụ.

quotaShare.conceptBorrowing: Ịgbaziri: igodo nwere ike iji nguzo efu nke ndị ọzọ n'emebighị oke kachasị

quotaShare.conceptWindows: Oge: 5h, kwa elekere, kwa ụbọchị, kwa izu, kwa ọnwa — a na-enyocha nke ọ bụla iche
quotaShare.conceptKeyHowTitle: Ime ka igodo nwee ike iji oke
quotaShare.conceptKeyHowDesc: Mepụta igodo ahụ dịka ọ na-adị na API Keys — ọ ga-apụta na nzọụkwụ igodo nke ọkachamara ahụ na-akpaghị aka. Kanye akara na Exclusive n'ebe ahụ iji mee ka ọ bụrụ naanị maka oke. Enweghị nzọụkwụ ọzọ iji mee ka ọ rụọ ọrụ.
quotaShare.conceptExclusiveDesc: Igodo exclusive na-ahụ/na-eji naanị ụdị quotaShared-* nke ọdọ oke ahụ — a na-ezobe ụdị ndị ọzọ niile na /v1/models ya ma gbochie ha.

quotaShare.stackedBarTitle: Nkewa dịka igodo API si dị
quotaShare.wizardStep1Subtitle: Họrọ akaụntụ onye na-eweta ọrụ nke ọdọ a ga-ekekọrịta oke ya, tọọ aha na iwu ndabara.

quotaShare.wizardStep3Subtitle: Kenye igodo API na ọdọ a, tinyere nkesa ịdị arọ n'ogo pasent na oke kachasị ndị bụ nhọrọ.

quotaShare.betaText: Quota Share na-arụ ọrụ mana a na-atụ anya ntụpọ. Ị hụrụ otu? Biko kọọ ya.

acpAgents.addCustomAgent: Tinye onye nnọchi anya ahaziri iche
acpAgents.addCustomAgentDesc: Debanye aha onye nnọchi anya CLI ahaziri iche ka e wee malite ya site na ACP.

omni-auth.name: Nyocha njirimara
omni-auth.description: Jikwaa nyocha njirimara site na igodo API na token nnọkọ. Malite ebe a iji Bearer token nyochaa arịrịọ, nweta kuki nnọkọ, ma hazie ihe achọrọ maka nbanye na OmniRoute API.

omni-providers.name: Ndị na-eweta ọrụ
omni-providers.description: Jikwaa njikọ ndị na-eweta ọrụ, igodo API, usoro OAuth, na ule njikọ site na REST API. Depụta, tinye, melite, wepụ, ma nwalee njikọta ndị na-eweta AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, na 160+).

omni-models.name: Ụdị
omni-models.description: Chọọ ụdị AI dị n'ofe ndị na-eweta ọrụ niile ahaziri. Depụta ụdị, chọpụta aha nnọchi ụdị, ma chọgharịa katalọgụ ụdị zuru ezu gụnyere ụdị pụrụ iche nke onye na-eweta ọ bụla.

omni-combos-routing.name: Ngwakọta na Nduzi Ụzọ
omni-combos-routing.description: Mepụta ma jikwaa ngwakọta nduzi ụzọ nwere atụmatụ 14 (ibu ụzọ, ịdị arọ, round-robin, Auto-combo, wdg.). Hazie usoro ndabere, nwalee nsonaazụ nduzi ụzọ, ma nweta metrik ngwakọta.

omni-api-keys.name: Igodo API
omni-api-keys.description: Mepụta, depụta, gbanwee, ma kagbuo igodo OmniRoute API. Jikwaa oke ikike, oke mmefu, na ụbọchị ngafe nke igodo ọ bụla. Igodo na-achịkwa ohere ịnweta ebe njedebe proxy na njikwa niile.

omni-usage-logs.name: Ojiji na Ndekọ
omni-usage-logs.description: Nweta ndekọ oku zuru ezu na nyocha ojiji. Nzacha site na onye na-eweta ọrụ, ụdị, oge, ọnọdụ, na ọnụ ahịa. Bupụ ndekọ ma chịkọta ojiji token n'ofe njikọ niile.

omni-budget.name: Mmefu Ego na Oke Ọsọ
omni-budget.description: Hazie oke mmefu, oke token, na iwu oke ọsọ maka igodo API ọ bụla ma ọ bụ n'ozuzu. Lelee ojiji dị ugbu a ma tinye njikwa ọnụ ahịa n'ọrụ n'ofe ndị na-eweta ọrụ.

omni-settings.name: Ntọala
omni-settings.description: Gụọ ma melite ntọala ngwa zuru ụwa ọnụ: mkpali sistemụ, oke echiche, ihe nzacha IP, iwu payload, ndabara ngwakọta, na nhazi nke chọrọ nbanye.

omni-proxies.name: Nhazi Proxy
omni-proxies.description: Hazie proxy HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS maka arịrịọ ezigara ndị na-eweta ọrụ. Tọọ iwu proxy maka onye na-eweta ọrụ ọ bụla ma ọ bụ n'ozuzu, nwalee njikọta, ma jikwaa ntụgharị proxy.

omni-cache.name: Ebe nchekwa nwa oge
omni-cache.description: Jikwaa cache nzaghachi LLM. Lelee ọnụ ọgụgụ cache, hichapụ ndenye, hazie iwu TTL, ma chịkwaa oke myirịta n'echiche maka itinye ihe na cache.

omni-compression.name: Mkpakọ
omni-compression.description: Hazie ụdị mkpakọ RTK (nsonaazụ iwu), Caveman (ederede nkọwa), na mkpakọ a tụkọtara ọnụ. Jikwaa ngwugwu asụsụ, iwu ahaziri iche, ma nwalee mkpakọ mkpali nke na-ebelata token site na 60–90%.

omni-context-rtk.name: Kontekstụ na RTK
omni-context-rtk.description: Hazie ihe nzacha RTK, iwu injinia kontekstụ, na ntọala nnyefe kontekstụ. Jiri ezigbo ihe atụ mkpali nwalee mkpakọ ma jikwaa usoro mgbanwe kontekstụ.

omni-resilience.name: Nkwụsi Ike na Nlekota
omni-resilience.description: Nyochaa ahụike ndị na-eweta ọrụ, ọnọdụ circuit-breaker, metrik oge nzaghachi p50/p95/p99, na ọkwa ịdọ aka ná ntị nche mmefu ego. Lelee oge nchere njikọ na mkpọchi ụdị ozugbo.

omni-cli-tools.name: Ngwaọrụ CLI
omni-cli-tools.description: Jikwaa njikọta ngwaọrụ CLI ndị API na-enye. Depụta, hazie, ma kpọọ ngwa mgbakwunye ngwaọrụ CLI ndị na-agbasawanye ikike akpaaka OmniRoute.

omni-tunnels.name: Ọwara
omni-tunnels.description: Mepụta ma jikwaa ọwara echedoro (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, nke ahaziri iche) iji mee ka OmniRoute dị n'ịntanetị ma ọ bụ kesaa ohere ya na ndị nnọchi anya nọ n'ebe dị anya na pipeline CI.

omni-sync-cloud.name: Mmekọrịta Cloud
omni-sync-cloud.description: Mekọrịta nhazi OmniRoute, njikọ ndị na-eweta ọrụ, na ntọala gaa na/si na nchekwa cloud. Jikwaa nkwenye njirimara cloud worker na ebe nchekwa ndabere dịpụrụ adịpụ.

omni-db-backups.name: Ebe Nchekwa Data na Nkwado Ndabere
omni-db-backups.description: Kpalite nkwado ndabere sistemụ, weghachite site na faịlụ ndabere, ma jikwaa okirikiri ndụ ebe nchekwa data SQLite. Ọ na-akwado mbupụ, mbubata, na atụmatụ snapshot na-abawanye nke nta nke nta.

omni-webhooks.name: Webhooks
omni-webhooks.description: Debanye aha, depụta, nwalee, ma wepụ ebe njedebe webhook. Hazie ndebanye aha ihe omume (request.completed, request.failed, quota.exceeded, wdg.) ma jikwaa mgbalị nnyefe ọzọ.

omni-mcp.name: Sava MCP
omni-mcp.description: Jikọọ na sava OmniRoute MCP (ngwaọrụ 110, ụzọ mbufe 3: SSE/stdio/HTTP). Ọ na-ekpuchi nduzi ụzọ, cache, mkpakọ, ebe nchekwa, nka, ndị na-eweta ọrụ, na ngwaọrụ nyocha n'ofe oke ikike 33.

omni-agents-a2a.name: Ndị Nnọchi Anya na Usoro A2A
omni-agents-a2a.description: Site na usoro agent-to-agent JSON-RPC 2.0, soro OmniRoute na-emekọrịta ihe. Nka A2A arụnyere n'ime ya dị 6: smart-routing, quota-management, provider-discovery, cost-analysis, health-report, list-capabilities.

omni-version-manager.name: Onye Njikwa Ụdị
omni-version-manager.description: Wụnye, malite, kwụsị, malitegharịa, ma melite ọrụ ndị etinyere n'ime ya (9Router, CLIProxyAPI). Nyochaa ọnọdụ ọrụ, nweta ndekọ, ma hazie mmalite-akpaka maka ebe njedebe ọrụ ndị bụ naanị nke mpaghara.

omni-inference.name: Ntụpụta (dakọtara na OpenAI)
omni-inference.description: Ebe njedebe ndị bụ isi maka ntụpụta dakọtara na OpenAI: mmezu nkata, embeddings, onyonyo, ọdịyo (TTS/STT), moderations, nhazigharị ọkwa, na Responses API. Nke a bụ ebe njikọta bụ isi maka ndị nnọchi anya AI.

cli-serve.name: CLI: Nye Ọrụ
cli-serve.description: Malite, kwụsị, ma malitegharịa sava OmniRoute site na CLI. Jikwaa ọnọdụ daemon, nhazi port, mgbake-akpaka, njikọta na system tray, na ụzọ mkpirisi maka imepe dashboard.

cli-health.name: CLI: Ahụike
cli-health.description: Lelee ahụike sava, ọnọdụ akụrụngwa, na metrik dị ndụ site na CLI. Gbaa `health`, `health components`, na `health watch` iji nweta dashboard ozugbo nke circuit breakers na ọnọdụ ndị na-eweta ọrụ.

cli-providers.name: CLI: Ndị Na-eweta Ọrụ
cli-providers.description: Jikwaa njikọ ndị na-eweta ọrụ site na CLI: depụta ndị na-eweta ọrụ dị ma ọ bụ ahaziri, tinye, nwalee, nwalee ha niile, kwado, gbanwee API keys, ma lee metrik nke onye na-eweta ọrụ ọ bụla.

cli-keys.name: CLI: Igodo API
cli-keys.description: Mepụta, depụta, gbanwee, ma kagbuo OmniRoute API keys site na CLI. Jikwaa usoro OAuth maka nkwenye njirimara onye na-eweta ọrụ, ma nyochaa ókè ikike na oge ngafe nke key.

cli-models.name: CLI: Ụdị
cli-models.description: Jụọ maka ụdị AI dị, depụta aha nnọchi nke ụdị, ma chọgharịa katalọgụ ụdị zuru ezu site na CLI. Họta dịka onye na-eweta ọrụ si dị, chọọ dịka ikike si dị, ma chọpụta ọdịiche dị iche iche nke aha model.

cli-chat.name: CLI: Nkata
cli-chat.description: Zipu mmezu nkata, zipu nzaghachi n'usoro iyi, ma malite nnọkọ REPL mmekọrịta site na CLI. Ọ na-akwado ndị na-eweta ọrụ OmniRoute niile, combo routing, na nhazi system prompt.

cli-routing.name: CLI: Routing na Combos
cli-routing.description: Mepụta, depụta, melite, ma hichapụ routing combos site na CLI. Nwalee atụmatụ routing, nyochaa metrik combo, ma hazie fallback chains n'ụzọ mmekọrịta.

cli-resilience.name: CLI: Nkwụsi Ike na Oke Ojiji
cli-resilience.description: Nyochaa ma jikwaa ọnọdụ circuit-breaker, oge nchere njikọ, oke quota, na ọkwa backoff site na CLI. Tọgharịa ndị na-eweta ọrụ rapaara ma hazie oke nkwụsi ike.

cli-compression.name: CLI: Mkpakọ
cli-compression.description: Hazie ma nwalee mkpakọ prompt site na CLI. Jikwaa RTK filters, iwu Caveman, ọnọdụ mkpakọ a kwakọtara ọnụ, ma jiri prompts n'ezie hụchalụ nsonaazụ mkpakọ.

cli-contexts.name: CLI: Contexts na Sessions
cli-contexts.description: Jikwaa nhazi context engineering, mkpokọta RTK filter, na nnọkọ mkparịta ụka site na CLI. Tinye ntọala context-relay ma nyochaa context pipelines na-arụ ọrụ.

cli-cost-usage.name: CLI: Ọnụ Ahịa na Ojiji
cli-cost-usage.description: Lee nkọwa ọnụ ahịa, ojiji token, na ndekọ oku site na CLI. Họta dịka onye na-eweta ọrụ, model, ma ọ bụ etiti ụbọchị si dị. Bupụ akụkọ ojiji ma nyochaa mmefu nke njikọ ọ bụla.

cli-mcp.name: CLI: MCP
cli-mcp.description: Nyochaa ọnọdụ sava MCP, depụta ngwaọrụ na scopes e debanyere aha, kpọọ ngwaọrụ ka ọ rụọ ọrụ, ma jikwaa ndekọ nyocha MCP site na CLI.

cli-a2a.name: CLI: Usoro A2A
cli-a2a.description: Site na CLI, soro sava OmniRoute A2A rụọkọ ọrụ. Zipu ọrụ, nyochaa akụkọ mmezu nka, ma nwalee JSON-RPC 2.0 agent-to-agent protocol n'ụzọ mmekọrịta.

cli-tunnel.name: CLI: Ọwara
cli-tunnel.description: Malite ma kwụsị njikọ tunnel (ngrok, Cloudflare, custom) site na CLI. Nyochaa URL tunnel ndị na-arụ ọrụ, hazie nkwenye njirimara, ma nwalee ma enwere ike iru ya site n'èzí.

cli-backup-sync.name: CLI: Nkwado Ndabere na Mmekọrịta
cli-backup-sync.description: Mee nkwado ndabere ma weghachite data OmniRoute site na CLI. Kpalite incremental snapshots, mekọrịta ya na cloud storage, jikwaa nhazi oge backup, ma weghachite data site na archive files.

cli-policy-audit.name: CLI: Iwu na Nnyocha
cli-policy-audit.description: Nyochaa ndekọ audit, jikwaa access policies, lee data telemetry, ma tụlee akụkọ arịrịọ site na CLI. Họta dịka ụdị ihe omume, onye ọrụ, ma ọ bụ etiti oge si dị maka usoro ọrụ nrubeisi.

cli-batches.name: CLI: Batches na Files
cli-batches.description: Nyefee ma nyochaa ọrụ batch inference site na CLI. Bulite ma jikwaa files maka batch processing, nweta nsonaazụ, ma jikọta batch pipelines na usoro ọrụ CI/CD.

cli-eval.name: CLI: Ntụle
cli-eval.description: Mepụta ma gbaa evaluation suites, lelee ọganihu benchmark dị ndụ, lee scorecards, tulee arụmọrụ model, ma jikọta eval runs na usoro ọrụ CI site na CLI.

cli-plugins-skills.name: CLI: Plugins, Nka na Ebe Nchekwa
cli-plugins-skills.description: Jikwaa Omni Skills (depụta, wụnye, nwalee, wepụ), plugins (mepụta, hazie), na ebe nchekwa na-adịgide adịgide (chọọ, tinye, hichapụ) site na CLI.

cli-setup.name: CLI: Ntọlite na Nhazi
cli-setup.description: Mee ntọlite mbụ, hazie mwube CLI zuru ụwa ọnụ, jikwaa environment variables, lelee mmelite, ma hazie autostart site na iwu setup na config nke CLI.

cli-skill-collector.name: CLI: Onye Nchịkọta Nka Agent
cli-skill-collector.description: Chọpụta ngwa coding CLI arụnyere (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline na ndị ọzọ), chọọ na GitHub maka nka agent dabara adaba, ma wụnye ha na ngwa ndị achọpụtara site na APIs arụnyere n'ime OmniRoute.

config-codex-cli.name: Nhazi: Codex CLI
config-codex-cli.description: Usoro ọrụ agent nke na-eduzi gị nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ iji hazie OpenAI Codex CLI na igwe ọ bụla (Linux, macOS, Windows) ka ọ jiri OmniRoute dịka backend dakọtara na OpenAI. Ọ na-achọpụta OS na shell, na-ede config.toml na profaịlụ 7 nwere aha, na-edobe environment variables, ma na-enyocha ntọlite ahụ.

omni-github-skills.name: Nchọpụta Nka na GitHub
omni-github-skills.description: Chọọ, nye akara, nyochaa, ma bubata nka agent site na repositories GitHub nwere SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, na faịlụ nka agent ndị yiri ha. Chọpụta nka ndị obodo mepụtara n'ofe ụdị provider karịrị 160, jiri heuristic scoring nyochaa mkpa ha, lelee ma e nwere malware ma ọ bụ secrets e dere kpọmkwem n'ime koodu, ma wụnye ha n'ime directories nke agent Hermes, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, ma ọ bụ OpenCode.

agentSkills.pageSubtitle: Kụziere agent gị ka ọ na-arụ ọrụ na OmniRoute — mpaghara API 23 + ezinụlọ CLI 21

agent.title: Nka Agent — Ọpụpụ
agent.description: Nka Agent bụ akwụkwọ SKILL.md igwe nwere ike ịgụ nke ndị agent AI mpụga (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot…) na-ebudata site na GitHub iji mụta otu esi eji REST ma ọ bụ CLI arụ ọrụ na OmniRoute. Agent na-agụ ha; OmniRoute anaghị agba ha ọsọ.

omni.title: Omni Skills — Mbata
omni.description: Omni Skills bụ ngwa sandbox nke OmniRoute na-etinye n'ime context nke model na arịrịọ ọ bụla. OmniRoute na-agba ha ọsọ; agent anaghị agụ ha.

freeProviderRankingsPage.title: Ọkwa Ndị Na-eweta Ọrụ N'efu
freeProviderRankingsPage.subtitle: Ndị na-eweta ọrụ n'efu kacha mma, ndị e depụtara n'ọkwa dịka akara ELO nke model sitere na bọọdụ ndị isi Arena AI
freeProviderRankingsPage.emptyState: Enweghị ọkwa dị ugbu a. Data Arena ELO na-emekọrịta mgbe usoro malitere (kwa ụbọchị) — lelee ọzọ n'oge na-adịghị anya, ma ọ bụ jiri aka gị kpalite mmekọrịta. Gbanyụọ Arena ELO Sync na Feature Flags ma ọ bụ tọọ ARENA_ELO_SYNC_ENABLED=false iji ghara isonye.
freeProviderRankingsPage.filterAvailableOnlyHelp: Zoo ndị na-enye ọrụ ndị njikọ ha niile erutela oke ojiji ma ọ bụ kwụsịrị n'ihi na oke ha agwụla.
freeProviderRankingsPage.configuredOnlyHint: Gosi naanị ndị na-enye ọrụ nwere njikọ ndị na-arụ ọrụ
freeProviderRankingsPage.noConfiguredProviders: Ahụghị onye na-enye ọrụ ọ bụla ahaziri. Buru ụzọ tinye njikọ onye na-enye ọrụ.

freeProviderRankingsPage.sortByReliability: Malite na nke kachasị ntụkwasị obi

freeProviderRankingsPage.typeLegend: Enweghị Ndebanye Aha = enweghị nhazi · Nbanye OAuth = jiri akaụntụ nke gị banye · Igodo API = weta igodo nke gị ma ọ bụ jiri ọkwa efu nke onye na-enye ọrụ ahụ
freeProviderRankingsPage.colReliabilityHelp: Pasent nke oku onye na-enye ọrụ a zara n'ezie n'ime awa 24 gara aga. Akara ogologo pụtara na ọ nyere data dị oke ole nke na-agaghị ekwe ka e kwuo ọnụego.

discovery.title: Nchọpụta Ndị Na-enye Ọrụ
discovery.subtitle: Nyochaa ndị na-enye ọrụ maka ụzọ nnweta efu/na-enweghị oke ma tụlee ihe achọpụtara. Ọ bụ naanị mgbe ị họọrọ iji ya, ọ na-arụkwa ọrụ naanị na ngwaọrụ a.
discovery.localOnlyNote: Ngwaọrụ a na-arụ ọrụ naanị na ngwaọrụ a (loopback). Nnyocha na-agba na kọmputa a, enweghịkwa ike iru ya site n'ebe dị anya.
discovery.verifyFailed: Nyocha izi ezi nke ihe achọpụtara dara.

ALLOW_API_KEY_REVEAL.description: Kwe ka ndị ọrụ dashboard e nyochara njirimara ha kpughee igodo API echekwara kama ịhụ naanị ụkpụrụ ezoro ezo.
