PROXY_AUTO_SELECT_ENABLED.description: Mgbe ekenyeghị proxy na njikọ, họrọ proxy registry mbụ na-arụ ọrụ na-akpaghị aka. A gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara n’ihi na ma ọ bụghị ya, otu proxy registry ga-abụ ihe ndabere zuru ụwa ọnụ maka okporo ụzọ niile (#3332).

OMNIROUTE_CONTROL_PLANE_PROXY_DIRECT_FAL.description: Kwe ka usoro OAuth na usoro nnyocha izi ezi provider gafee proxy e kenyere mgbe nyocha nnweta proxy dara. A gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara n’ihi na nke a nwere ike ịgbanwe IP ọpụpụ akaụntụ ahụ.

MITM_DISABLE_TLS_VERIFY.description: Gbanyụọ nkwenye asambodo TLS maka proxy MITM.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Kwe ka URL ndị provider na-atụ aka na netwọkụ nkeonwe ma ọ bụ nke ime.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Kwe ka ndị provider nọ na localhost, LAN, na mpaghara IP nkeonwe. A chọrọ nke a maka model mpaghara ndị kwekọrọ na OpenAI, a na-akwadokwa ya na ndabara. A ka na-egbochi endpoint metadata cloud dịka 169.254.169.254.

ENABLE_CC_COMPATIBLE_PROVIDER.description: Kwado ọnọdụ provider kwekọrọ na Claude Code.

TOOL_POLICY_MODE.description: Tọọ ọnọdụ mmanye iwu maka ojiji tool.

RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_ENABLE.description: Kwado mmachi ọsọ na-akpaghị aka dabere n’usoro ojiji.

ALLOW_MULTI_CONNECTIONS_PER_COMPAT_NODE.description: Kwe ka e nwee ọtụtụ njikọ maka node ndakọrịta ọ bụla.

DISABLE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHECKS.label: Gbanyụọ Nnyocha Context Window
DISABLE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHECKS.description: Mafere nyocha context-window mpaghara nke OmniRoute na max-input-token maka arịrịọ kpọmkwem nke otu model. Ndị provider upstream ka na-amanye oke ha n’ezie. Mkpakọ prompt na oke output-token ka na-arụ ọrụ.

RESPONSES_PASSTHROUGH_DROP_COMMENTARY.description: Wepụ item mmepụta nke commentary-phase dị n’ime na stream passthrough nke Responses API tupu iziga ha n’ihu nye client. Gbanyụọ flag a iji nata commentary upstream na-enweghị nhazi.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_ENFORCE_SCOPES.description: Manye mmachi scope maka nnweta tool MCP.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_COMPRESS_DESCRIPTIONS.description: Pakọba nkọwa tool MCP iji belata ojiji token.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_SERVICES.description: Gbanyụọ ọrụ background niile, gụnyere mmelite quota na synchronization.

OMNIROUTE_RTK_TRUST_PROJECT_FILTERS.description: Tụkwasị filter RTK nke ọkwa project obi na-enweghị validation.

OMNIROUTE_ENABLE_LIVE_WS.description: Bido sava WebSocket dashboard nke real-time mgbe e mere import na port loopback 20132. Tọọ flag ahụ ka ọ bụrụ 0 ma ọ bụ false iji gbanyụọ ya. Ikpughe ya na LAN chọkwara LIVE_WS_HOST=0.0.0.0 na LIVE_WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

OMNIROUTE_CODEX_WS_ENABLED.description: Kwe ka Codex jiri Responses site na WebSocket. Mgbe agbanyụrụ ya, Codex na-alaghachi na HTTP Responses.

OMNIROUTE_EMERGENCY_FALLBACK.description: Duga arịrịọ ndị budget ha gwụchara na provider na model ndabere mberede n’efu.

STREAM_RECOVERY_ENABLED.description: Nwaa stream SSE upstream ndị e bepụrụ ọzọ n’enweghị ka client mara tupu byte nzaghachi ọ bụla erute client.

STREAM_RECOVERY_MIDSTREAM_ENABLED.description: Kwe ka mgbake stream rịọ nzaghachi ahụ ọzọ ma jikọta ya mgbe byte ruterelarị client.

STREAM_RECOVERY_TOOLCALL_ORDER_FIX.description: Mee ka continuation n’etiti stream dị nchebe maka tool call: agala n’ihu ọzọ na stream e kwụsịrị mgbe ezipụchara tool call (ma ọ ka na-aga n’ihu ma ọ bụ na ọ gwụla), kwụsịkwa mgbe continuation efu mere otu ugboro kama iji retry budget niile.

STREAM_EARLY_EOF_SIBLING_FAILOVER_ENABLE.description: Gafee otu ugboro gaa na njikọ ibe mgbe stream mechiri tupu o zipụta frame ọ bụla bara uru, ma nnwale ọzọ e nyere oke n'otu njikọ ahụ agwụla. Ọ bụrụ na enweghị njikọ ibe a pụrụ iji, a ga-eweghachi njehie early-EOF mbụ ahụ. Gbanyụọ: early-EOF ga-anọgide bụrụ njedebe mgbe nnwale ọzọ gasịrị.

MODEL_CATALOG_INCLUDE_NAMES.description: Tinye field aha dị mfe igosi na nzaghachi /v1/models. Gbanyụọ nke a maka client ndị na-anabata naanị ID model.

MODELS_CATALOG_PREFIX_MODE.description: Jikwaa prefix ID model na /v1/models: dual na-ewepụta prefix alias na canonical, alias na-ewepụta naanị prefix dị mkpụmkpụ, ebe canonical na-ewepụta naanị ID provider zuru ezu.

ARENA_ELO_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Na-emekọrịta data ELO nke leaderboard Arena AI kwa oge maka ogo ọgụgụ-isi model.

CLI_COMPAT_ALL.description: Kwado ọnọdụ ndakọrịta maka client CLI niile.

PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Mekọrịta data ọnụahịa na-akpaghị aka. PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED environment variable ga-abụkwa true.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CODEX_PROFILES.description: Mgbe emekọrịtachara provider-model, mepụtaghachi profaịlụ ~/.codex/*.config.toml site na katalọgụ dị ugbu a. Nke a anaghị agbanwe nhazi Codex na-arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụ nke ndabara, a gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CLAUDE_PROFILES.description: Mgbe emekọrịtachara provider-model, mepụtaghachi profaịlụ ~/.claude/profiles/'<name>'/settings.json site na katalọgụ dị ugbu a. Nke a anaghị agbanwe nhazi Claude na-arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụ nke ndabara, a gbanyụrụ ya na ndabara.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_TOKEN_HEALTHCHECK.description: Gbanyụọ nyocha ahụike maka nkwado token.

SERVER_OWNED_TOOL_LOOP_ENABLED.description: Gaa n'ihu na oku ngwaọrụ sava na-achịkwa ndị na-abụghị streaming ruo mgbe model weghachiri nzaghachi onye ahịa nwere ike iji.

RETRY_AFTER_PROVENANCE_ENABLED.label: Isi mmalite Retry-After
RETRY_AFTER_PROVENANCE_ENABLED.description: Na nzaghachi 429/503 ndị agbakọtara nke na-egosi enweghị nnweta, etinyela Retry-After mgbe a maghị kpọmkwem oge nnwale ọzọ n'ọdịnihu kama izipu 1s e chepụtara echepụta; tinye error.retry_after_provenance, ma gụọ ntụnye nnwale ọzọ ndị e dere n'ahịrịokwu n'ụzọ combo drain.

PROTECTED_PRIORITY_INFRA_502_ENABLED.label: Nkwụsị Akụrụngwa nke Prioriti Echedoro dịka 502
PROTECTED_PRIORITY_INFRA_502_ENABLED.description: Zaghachi 502 kama 503 mgbe ebumnuche prioriti quota-only-fallback kwụsịrị combo n'ihi ihe e gosipụtara na ọ bụghị quota: provider circuit breaker mepere emepe ma ọ bụ predictive latency skip.

radarPage.accessScaleTitle: Ghọta ohere Radar tupu ime ka ọ rụọ ọrụ
radarPage.accessScaleIntro: Radar agaghị eji netwọkụ ruo mgbe ị họọrọ isonye. Họrọ ohere Community ma ọ bụ mee ka supporter key nkeonwe rụọ ọrụ mgbe ị tụlechara iwu ndị a.
radarPage.accessCommunityRule: Community — a chọghị key: katalọgụ zuru ezu nwere igbu oge ụbọchị 30.
radarPage.accessSingleUseRule: Star + follow — mgbe GitHub OAuth kwadoro ha abụọ, akaụntụ GitHub gị ga-enweta otu ọgụgụ katalọgụ live; emesịa, ohere ahụ ga-alaghachi na Community. Enweghị ike inye akaụntụ ahụ ohere otu oge a ọzọ.
radarPage.accessContributorRule: Ndị nyere aka — PR ndị ejikọtara, commit, na ahịrị koodu na-ekpebi naanị nhazi ọkwa kwa izu. Ndị nọ na Top 10 na-enweta ụbọchị 365; ọkwa 11–100 na-enweta ụbọchị 90; ndị nyere aka nọghị na Top 100 anaghị enweta onyinye n'agbanyeghị ọnụ ọgụgụ PR ha. Ịpụ na nhazi ọkwa agaghị ebelata oge enyerelarị.
radarPage.accessSupporterRule: Ndị nkwado — ịzụrụ otu ugboro na-enye ọnwa 6, otu afọ, ma ọ bụ ogologo ndụ na-enweghị mmegharị akpaka. Ịzụrụ, onyinye ego, oge ndị nyere aka, na onyinye ejiri aka nye na-agbakọta; ohere ogologo ndụ na-aka ha niile.
radarPage.accessInstallationRule: Ikikere nkeonwe — jiri key ahụ n'otu nrụnye na-arụ ọrụ n'otu oge. OmniRoute anaghị eji akara mkpịsị aka amata ngwaike. Mgbake na-akagbu key furu efu ma dochie ya n'enweghị ịtọgharịa ụbọchị ngwụcha ya.
radarPage.accessAbuseRule: Nyocha mmegbu — IP nke anọ dị iche n'ime awa 24 na-emepụta naanị akara maka nyocha mmadụ; ọ naghị egbochi ma ọ bụ kagbuo key na-akpaghị aka.
radarPage.accessOffersRule: A na-eji aka ahọpụta onyinye live, ha nwekwara ike ịgbanwe ma ọ bụ kubie ume.
radarPage.privacyDownloadsRule: Nbudata — nrụnye gị na-enweta katalọgụ na metadata ntụnye aka e ji mbinye aka kriptografik kwado; live key ziri ezi na-emeghekwa onyinye na Intel e binyere aka.
radarPage.privacySendsRule: Ihe a na-eziga — mmekọrịta n'akụkụ sava na-eziga igodo onye nkwado dịka Bearer token, ebe akụrụngwa HTTPS na-enweta IP njikọ ahụ. Ndekọ arịrịọ feed anaghị echekwa nke ọ bụla n'ime ha n'ụdị mbụ ya: ọ na-edowe hashes igodo, mkpokọta ojiji, na IP HMAC e belatara nke na-agbanwe kwa ụbọchị maka nyocha mmegbu.
radarPage.privacyNeverRule: Ihe anaghị anakọta ma ọlị — prompts, nzaghachi, mkparịta ụka, nzere provider, okporo ụzọ model, oge ọrụ, latency, na nhazi provider mpaghara anaghị eziga na Radar ma ọlị.

globalError.description: Njehie a na-atụghị anya ya mere. Edekọla nke a, ndị otu anyị ga-enyochakwa ya.

offline.title: Nsogbu Njikọ
offline.description: OmniRoute enweghị ike ijikọ na netwọkụ ugbu a. Lelee ntọala ịntanetị, VPN, ma ọ bụ proxy gị.

maintenance.title: Mmezi A Haziri Ahazi
maintenance.description: Ụfọdụ ọrụ anaghị adị nwa oge ka mmezi na-aga n’ihu. Usoro ntụgharị bụ isi na-anọkarị n'ịntanetị, mana njirimara njikwa nwere ike ghara ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma.
maintenance.suggestion1: Nwaa ọzọ mgbe nkeji ole na ole gachara.
maintenance.suggestion2: Lelee ihe ngosi ahụike dị ugbu a na ọnọdụ ndị na-eweta ọrụ tupu ị nwaa ọzọ.

status.title: Ọnọdụ Sistemụ
status.description: Nchịkọta ọrụ dị ugbu a maka ọrụ ndị bụ isi nke OmniRoute.
status.failedToLoad: Ibugo ọnọdụ ahụike sistemụ kụrụ afọ n'ala.
status.unableToReachHealth: Enweghị ike iru endpoint ahụike. Lelee njikọ wee nwaa ọzọ.

400.title: Arịrịọ Na-ezighi Ezi
400.description: Payload arịrịọ ahụ ezighi ezi ma ọ bụ ezughị ezu.
400.suggestion1: Nyochaa oghere ndị achọrọ na usoro payload tupu ị nwaa ọzọ.
400.suggestion2: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji API, nyochaa JSON schema ahụ na gburugburu mpaghara gị.
400.suggestion3: Ọ bụrụ na nke a na-eme ugboro ugboro, mepee arịrịọ ahụ na Translator Playground iji nyochaa payload ahụ.

401.title: Enweghị Ikikere
401.description: Achọrọ nkwenye njirimara iji nweta akụrụngwa a.
401.suggestion1: Banye ọzọ wee nwaa ọrụ ahụ ọzọ.
401.suggestion2: Maka oku API, gosi na Bearer token dị ma bụrụ nke ziri ezi.
401.suggestion3: Ọ bụrụ na a gbanwere token ahụ n'oge na-adịbeghị anya, melite nzere onye ahịa gị.

403.title: Amachibidoro
403.description: A ghọtara arịrịọ gị, mana amụma machibidoro nnweta.
403.suggestion1: Lelee iwu ndepụta IP ndị e kwere/ndị egbochiri na ntọala.
403.suggestion2: Nyochaa iwu model na mmefu ego e kenyere igodo API gị.
403.suggestion3: Rịọ onye nchịkwa ka o nye oke ikike achọrọ.

408.title: Oge Arịrịọ Agwụla
408.description: Sava enwetaghị arịrịọ zuru ezu n'oge.
408.suggestion1: Jiri payload pere mpe nwaa arịrịọ ahụ ọzọ.
408.suggestion2: Lelee nkwụsi ike netwọkụ gị na igbu oge VPN/proxy.
408.suggestion3: Maka ọrụ na-ewe ogologo oge, gbanye streaming ma ọ bụ kewaa arịrịọ ahụ.

429.title: Arịrịọ Karịrị Oke
429.description: A gafere oke ọnụego maka onye ahịa, igodo, ma ọ bụ provider a.
429.suggestion1: Chere ka oge nkwụsị gafee ma nwaa ọzọ mgbe nkeji oge a tụrụ aro gasịrị.
429.suggestion2: Gbanwee gaa na ngwakọta nwere provider ndị ga-anọchi ma ọ daa.
429.suggestion3: Hazie profaịlụ nkwụsi ike/oke ọnụego provider na ntọala.

500.title: Njehie Dị N'ime Sava
500.description: Njehie sava a na-atụghị anya ya mere mgbe a na-ahazi arịrịọ gị.
500.suggestion1: Nwaa ọzọ otu ugboro mgbe sekọnd ole na ole gasịrị.
500.suggestion2: Lelee telemetry ahụike na ndekọ sava maka ID arịrịọ ndị metụtara ya.
500.suggestion3: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-aga n'ihu, jiri timestamp na ọnọdụ arịrịọ kọwaa nsogbu ahụ.

502.title: Gateway Na-adịghị Mma
502.description: Provider upstream ma ọ bụ njikọ gateway weghachiri nzaghachi na-ezighi ezi.
502.suggestion1: Jiri provider ọzọ ma ọ bụ ụzọ ngwakọta na-arụ ọrụ nwaa ọzọ.
502.suggestion2: Lelee nzere provider na ịdị adị nke model.
502.suggestion3: Nyochaa nsonaazụ translator ma ọ bụrụ na ntụgharị format so na ya.

503.title: Ọrụ Adịghị Ugbu a
503.description: Ọrụ ahụ adịghị nwa oge n'ihi mmezi ma ọ bụ dependencies ndị arụmọrụ ha dara.
503.suggestion1: Chere obere oge wee nwaa ọzọ.
503.suggestion2: Lelee ọkwa mmezi na ọnọdụ sistemụ.
503.suggestion3: Jiri ndị na-eweta ọrụ ndabere ma ọ bụrụ na usoro ọrụ gị na-adabere na obere oge nzaghachi.
